Peter,
You hanging in there? The past week has been a dizzying mix of chaos, corruption, and—dare we say—a small, fleeting victory for the rule of law.
Let's break it down:
Musk and His Goon Squad Run Wild
Elon Musk is still roaming the halls of government like he owns the place, waltzing from agency to agency with his hand-picked goons in tow. Who are these fine, upstanding public servants? One was fired for leaking private data at his last job, and another has a history of racist tweets advocating eugenics. These guys now have access to sensitive government information and are helping decide which federal programs live or die. Nothing to see here, right?
Trump's Foreign Policy: Beachfront Property in Gaza?
At this point, we almost hesitate to call it "policy." During an off-the-cuff rant, Trump floated the idea of the U.S. taking over the Gaza Strip—because he's apparently interested in the beachfront real estate opportunities. While the State Department scrambles to contain the fallout, the world is left to process the fact that the President of the United States is making "policy" that sounds like a timeshare pitch.
Musk Kills Consumer Protections
In his latest move to protect billionaires and screw over everyday Americans, Musk helped shut down the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB)—the agency that has returned over $20 billion to consumers duped or defrauded by shady businesses! If you've ever gotten a refund from a scammy company or a predatory lender, you can thank the CFPB. But not anymore. Musk and his billionaire friends made sure of that.
The Courts Are Holding—For Now
In a rare bit of good news, the courts have stepped in to block some of Trump's most extreme policies, including his attempt to end birthright citizenship and freezes on government spending. It's proof that our institutions can still work—but it's also a stark reminder of how fragile they are. The moment we stop fighting, Trump and his enablers will push their most radical agenda yet.
We can't stop Trump and Musk from running amok in Washington overnight. But we can fight back in 2025 by winning key elections, putting good civil servants in office, and educating voters on why these policies are corrupt, dangerous, and not remotely normal.

clean_body: We want to know: Do you approve of RFK Jr. to lead the Department of Health and Human Services? While Washington remains gridlocked, Dr. Raul Ruiz is committed to serving and helping constituents with the problems they have with the federal government and cutting red tape. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | With confirmation hearings for Donald Trump’s Cabinet nominations underway, we wanted your opinion on the pick Team Ruiz is most concerned about (and that’s saying something): Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Since the moment Donald Trump announced that RFK Jr. would be his pick to be the next U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services, Americans have been concerned about the prospect of someone with a history of denying science taking the position. | | | | As a physician, one of Dr. Ruiz’s top priorities is ensuring that every American has access to quality, affordable health care. While it’s impossible to say for sure what RFK Jr.’s confirmation would mean for American health care, his history of denying the effectiveness of vaccines and other medical practices that have long been proven safe by science is certainly cause for concern. But before that, I want to hear from you. | | | — Ruiz HQ | | | ---|---|--- = The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. With each investment for college, he made a promise to come back home and serve his community as a physician. name: Andrew Yang
subject: Within and Without
body:
So what do leaders do around the world? There are 3 things that inspiring leaders universally do in different countries. | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=6f5ef3174b&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=6903229ed0&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| Hello, I hope that you and yours are doing well. What can we do to be better at what we do? I went to a friend’s book launch party a few weeks ago and met Adam Galinsky. Adam is a Columbia business school professor who studies effective leadership. He wrote a book called “Inspire: The Universal Path for Leading Yourself and Others” that came out last week. I have a few rules for leadership: Try to work on something important that’s bigger than yourself. Compensate people fairly. And care about the people you work with. But Adam is a little more data-driven than that. “I’ve studied what makes leaders effective and it turns out the qualities and attributes are the same across countries and cultures.” Adam joined me for the podcast this week. So what do leaders do around the world? “There are 3 things that inspiring leaders universally do in different countries. Number one, they’re visionary: that is, they set a vision or goal for others to follow. Number two, they’re exemplars of desired behavior: they act in a way that’s an example for others, often being cool and composed even in the most stressful of situations. Number three, they’re mentors who encourage, empower and elevate others to reach their potential.” Adam uses copious examples. In one case, there’s a pilot who tells people on a plane with a mechanical failure, “We’re not going down. We are going to Philly.” It keeps everyone calm. She listens to her co-pilot’s advice, lands the plane and comes out to meet with and comfort passengers. On the other hand, there’s a boat captain who doesn’t tell passengers anything as the boat lists and starts sinking. He tries to blame others and deflect responsibility for the mishap, endangering those on the vessel. Good leadership is infectious. “When I have asked people around the globe to describe the feeling of being inspired, they frequently use words like bright, light, and warmth. Others describe it as a mix of awe, admiration, and wonder. And many recognize it as a wellspring of hope and possibility.” “The flipside of inspiring leadership is infuriating leadership. It turns out there’s an enduring continuum, and everything falls somewhere between these two extremes.” We’ve all seen and experienced bad leadership. Adam identifies the gatekeeper who seems to delight in using their power in negative ways. Happily, Adam says that we can actually create more good leaders. “The three dimensions of an inspiring leader are universal because each one fulfills a set of fundamental human needs. Visionary fulfills the human need for meaning and purpose. Exemplar fulfills the human need for protection and passion. Mentor fulfills the human need for support and status.” Adam identifies an ability for people to get better at any of these attributes. “Each of us an learn, nurture and develop the capacity to be better in these respects. There are concrete actions to take and practices to pursue.” As you know, I constantly have an eye on how we can make the world a better place. But the primary place to start is within ourselves. As Thomas R. Kelly wrote, “We Western people are apt to think our great problems are external, environmental. We are not skilled in the inner life, where the real roots of our problems lie.” We can’t control what others do, but we can improve what we do. And that, for those in our lives, may be the most important thing. For Adam’s book on inspiring leadership, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=02b07423d4&e=0f227c2ae3). For my interview with him, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=305ab76442&e=0f227c2ae3). clean_body: So what do leaders do around the world? There are 3 things that inspiring leaders universally do in different countries. | | | | | | | | | Hello, I hope that you and yours are doing well. What can we do to be better at what we do? I went to a friend’s book launch party a few weeks ago and met Adam Galinsky. Adam is a Columbia business school professor who studies effective leadership. He wrote a book called “Inspire: The Universal Path for Leading Yourself and Others” that came out last week. I have a few rules for leadership: Try to work on something important that’s bigger than yourself. Compensate people fairly. And care about the people you work with. But Adam is a little more data-driven than that. “I’ve studied what makes leaders effective and it turns out the qualities and attributes are the same across countries and cultures.” Adam joined me for the podcast this week. So what do leaders do around the world? “There are 3 things that inspiring leaders universally do in different countries. Number one, they’re visionary: that is, they set a vision or goal for others to follow. Number two, they’re exemplars of desired behavior: they act in a way that’s an example for others, often being cool and composed even in the most stressful of situations. Number three, they’re mentors who encourage, empower and elevate others to reach their potential.” Adam uses copious examples. In one case, there’s a pilot who tells people on a plane with a mechanical failure, “We’re not going down. We are going to Philly.” It keeps everyone calm. She listens to her co-pilot’s advice, lands the plane and comes out to meet with and comfort passengers. On the other hand, there’s a boat captain who doesn’t tell passengers anything as the boat lists and starts sinking. He tries to blame others and deflect responsibility for the mishap, endangering those on the vessel. Good leadership is infectious. “When I have asked people around the globe to describe the feeling of being inspired, they frequently use words like bright, light, and warmth. Others describe it as a mix of awe, admiration, and wonder. And many recognize it as a wellspring of hope and possibility.” “The flipside of inspiring leadership is infuriating leadership. It turns out there’s an enduring continuum, and everything falls somewhere between these two extremes.” We’ve all seen and experienced bad leadership. Adam identifies the gatekeeper who seems to delight in using their power in negative ways. Happily, Adam says that we can actually create more good leaders. “The three dimensions of an inspiring leader are universal because each one fulfills a set of fundamental human needs. Visionary fulfills the human need for meaning and purpose. Exemplar fulfills the human need for protection and passion. Mentor fulfills the human need for support and status.” Adam identifies an ability for people to get better at any of these attributes. “Each of us an learn, nurture and develop the capacity to be better in these respects. There are concrete actions to take and practices to pursue.” As you know, I constantly have an eye on how we can make the world a better place. But the primary place to start is within ourselves. As Thomas R. Kelly wrote, “We Western people are apt to think our great problems are external, environmental. We are not skilled in the inner life, where the real roots of our problems lie.” We can’t control what others do, but we can improve what we do. And that, for those in our lives, may be the most important thing. For Adam’s book on inspiring leadership, click . For my interview with him, click . body:
Don't Miss Out...

| [ ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaIOiUFGhm1XQHaiZ59fvCoY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_1_have_you_got_your_okgop_li&n=1)
---
Peter -- Have you got your OKGOP Lincoln Day Dinner Tickets yet? What are you waiting for? There are only a few weeks left till the BIG EVENT takes place on the evening of February 28, 2025, at 7:00 pm in the Embassy Church Ballroom located in Tulsa. You will not want to miss the special event! This years event promises to be an entertaining, informative and unique experience as we will be having Mr. Larry Elliott, an Abraham Lincoln portrayer along with his wife as Mary Lincoln. Together they will take you first person from the birth of our 16th President through his life, the battle to save our republic and ultimately to his tragic death at Ford’s Theater at the hands of assassin John Wilkes Booth. Mr. Elliott has performed as President Lincoln for over 20 years and remains in full character throughout the entire evening helping to create the illusion of having the President right there in the room with you. It is our intent for this event to bring a clear focus on the 16th President, his life and the monumental impact this man had on our nation’s history. Additionally invitations are being sent to all members of the Oklahoma Congressional Delegation and will be emceed by Dr. Howard Hatcher. We hope that you will join us for the one of a kind experience and believe you will find this program to be a very enjoyable and memorable night. Please see the attached invitation for event details and registration or [register here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=C6hV7_0XX72mlOYFbGdwPxYbMCrjzVLTzfoE0zb37ZAagnXWDWvjj5k3u3FIYXXNsRg-vAlvf2JCcmn5aZEQ3A&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_1_have_you_got_your_okgop_li&n=2). The Conservative Caucus hosts a sold out event at The Drake in Oakbrook. (TCC)
By Illinois Review

ICYMI — Last week over 200 grassroots conservatives gathered at the Drake Hotel in Oakbrook as a sold out and energized crowd gathered to discuss how to flip Illinois red.

The Conservative Caucus – led by president Jim Pfaff – hosted the event. Pfaff’s political career spans over three decades and includes having served as Chief of Staff for two different congressmen – U.S. Rep. Thomas Massie, R-KY and U.S. Rep. Tim Huelskamp, R-KS. He also served as president of the Colorado Family Institute, and he was a representative for Family Policy Councils at Focus on the Family. Pfaff is also widely respected around the country for his grassroots expertise and he has a long history of winning campaigns at every level.

TCC Development Director Janelle Towne and TCC State Director Jacqueline Garretson, who serve on Pfaff’s team organized the event.

The speaker lineup included former Illinois Gov. Rod Blagojevich, J6 patriot Kash Kelly – who was imprisoned by the Biden administration for three years for being in the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021 and peacefully exercising his right to protest, and Chicago Flips Red cofounder Jessica Jackson.

| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zsobtak2hb5h0mt1t2hbf1ka4pthn5opg3s8obbg_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s9jmcob6cdh2bs)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

**Three pivotal House races are heading to special elections, and the radical Left is pouring everything they have into flipping these districts.**
They want to crush our America First agenda and take full control of Congress. _The stakes could not be higher._
Losing seats means **losing the House majority** and losing the progress President Trump has made.
Losing seats means **Agenda 47 will be stopped dead** and we will have to fight even harder over every single thing in the House, like we had to in 2017 and 2018.
DNC Operatives and Deep State cronies are being flown in from all across the country to mobilize Democrat's efforts in these districts.
Leaked memos show **there have already been fundraising calls from Democrats** with activist billionaires and special interest groups to try to dump as many resources as possible into the fight.

We must hold **NY-21** , **FL-01** , and **FL-06**.
The fight starts here _and it starts with you_.
We must win every seat to protect all of the progress President Trump has made so far.
It could be decades before we have another opportunity to advance our America First cause like this with Republican control of the **House of Representatives** , the **Senate,** and** White House**.
**__[This is your moment to make a difference and defend the GOP trifecta. Will you stand strong and help defend our majority](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9ZIH/?__vbtrk=Mjc0ODkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc0ODkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_?_**

There’s a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/s/c/mahCLcSzN8SY5L5K51lX2matMj1zQM3bzgcrwkJMVezy_x9Zlkh9Lk9YCzu5u2fY30LK3JZr-RMuBhIDII6vDYFx-mmSJ9N2vOlv7cttigIfFSbQlCDeqLwLqByNYR8tjUyF-PR-QLH3SqRDY_iq62mbSM4L1IzVGaJKoxLBMnWwMbMjeod9ZJPSSRiaCrumihAQtOx8njBOvrj4ceZgIOcgLCDVmz3GPRO8cWqWkF-tNKQzDuOlcHZTV0iiv_fhH7zh39A5dpVJ2rQ4ScHXe8dk15DNzxvCO3dAwhK_xK4CtCJYFoQ5PRxsT_rczI_2EDie7M8Iuk7wUuXK6N5MLmS1IyFERfEmZNkT39vNiHY1MFY3ALGcPt5ngeVDV7kHWUIFS0SoW8mWTDLiWW04Pl_lKFeqS5_MRpphSxq_00Fspk9S5A7LxDxy5egk89TSozp83xq8u_o36GhkIGTUSg/6f3rvF1ySbbj5gmk3MctbrqmcrJ1xgzY/5)

| | Dear Friend,

There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it is...What is true about the world?

Tough, right?

It's a question mankind has asked since ancient times--since creation itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do, email me because I would love to know more!).

This question is especially pressing today because of the growing power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material world.

That's one of the reasons we released our free online course, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Why chemistry?

For one, this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to millions of Americans, including you.

More fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as humans in the world around us and reveals the framework, implications, and potential for human life.

And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect: after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t. When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families. Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. ## Ceasefire at Risk as Hamas Stalls Hostage Release
Hamas said it was [postponing the next scheduled release of Israeli hostages](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7mOrDAQheGnsbNGRXmBDhzchKxvOiHyUkBNm0VggfrtR0w-Jz3SJ_1fr_7lOfMy_vczuTKsPQKaB-CjrvvkOX96LZMbiJCUJFc36okNGjBycnp4mhjA-joiYFReqRTQYiBjW2OTZHdrgPU9A1hB0A2pGJUnbds2CQ2UuKx79b3yUiYa8mc9aa_iOsvsplK2Q6h_AjuB3XVdVQjx_gR2C12HwC7zSQK7iGDs-d7e-1jk7tJ2cc582EZoGGfP-VcsfxWeDn8CAAD__7nUUaU), putting the ceasefire agreement at risk as Israel raised its military readiness to high alert. Hamas accused Israel of delaying the return of displaced Palestinians to northern Gaza, targeting them with shelling and gunfire, and failing to allow the entry of agreed-upon humanitarian aid. In response, Israeli Defense Minister Israel [Katz condemned Hamas's actions](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL-O8yAQxJ_G7ohg-ecUFF-TLl97pbWBJd4TNpFBifz2J19_U81opNHo93Wf78iFt-d_XCn0XGeQYIUEodSckMsxmzGFTASkRwrK6yt4sNKOS8heRZLJT5LsIyeXEeGhs5-szskDjBzONQnqlJVwkQ_jSceokYybpjQYSYl73S_flbe-UC5HfdN-iXUdS1h6f7VB_xvgNsANXxt92lmdYe8cCw1wW3DFJpbaOj5J7FQIG4lEBQ8RT595J_HmWrBz3ZrwLrmcrsqBcjJfrTWZovbSKG3AKzPuIb0-XAo35wcjnyty-X3U_yL0DvATAAD__ymLZ3k) as a "complete violation" of the ceasefire and instructed the Israeli military to prepare for any possible scenario in Gaza. President Trump said the Israel-Hamas [ceasefire should be canceled](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0jz2PtCAURn8NdBi4fIgFxdvYzdtuaVi5jneDYpR1Mv9-w_b7tCc5T87HY3pEyrQ__8cNQ13KBBKskCCUmlKk_J4MT2FBBNQcg-r1AD1YafkazOA9uLlPNjnvB6UWZVR0bomzjV4rTqHZJKg2K6GTn6ZHPc86onHeJ2YkJqrl7L4K7XXFJb_LjWc3l43nsNZ6XEz_YzAyGOOx4-tqiMGY6UYGYyp7zEnU83s7RMMChJKi3fIzpONFOdPlembkc4uUf8X1r9A7wE8AAAD__6L8Uxo) if Hamas does not release all remaining hostages by midday Saturday, though he acknowledged the final decision is up to Israel.
## Judge Extends Pause in Buyout Plan
A Massachusetts federal judge on Monday [extended indefinitely](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2L9CAURn-N6Qx6NR9TWLzwkm62WZYtg3qvGQczDsbMkH-_ZPt92gcOh_N9na82pvhYPuxKpoY8g4COC-BSzmhjOmbdoAlEQKohIwd1gQE60TU3M0onA2qpgnOBfLBy1GpE7zu8DMqLJpqTJkCe6wS0wumBlPfKku7HEZkWhLHm0t5zfNQbhXTkF5XW57VJ5lbrc2PqH4OJwWSdf9B7a5d83gymr08G033HhTiSj0g82Eq8ln19bjwQUrGJu_3Ie-U5BCoMpq3mcjA1RWTqv5Rjr0H3uikGn--YUtz6gWmxrDamX4v6V5WXgZ8AAAD__19zZA8) the pause on the Trump administration's buyout plan for federal employees, just hours before the deadline. The plan offered over 2 million remote federal workers eight months of pay and benefits if they didn't want to return to working full-time in the office. [Over 65,000 federal workers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOszAQBOCnMd1Gy2Ji_sLF37jLtVciB6-DE4ORbRLx9ieuv2lH-jSa79t4syGG9fFlF9bVp5GQekCCth2dDfEYZeO0ZybuGtat6v6Roh77ZtaKHU8OZd_fsXN-GKy0g-r8ZAdEJX0T9KkhtWd6pAvepeJumjrL8joMTkhkF2rKl2cKa53ZxyO9OV-mtDRRz7VuRXT_BRlBZj22VOpZCTInLMggCTItCjJ7gZU_RZDx7DjbCM_dPRhmG2uBmvdlK-DZwSflF2e470faawHrK2e49i-o9sWwb1BnhuQ9Z0GmydptnxBjKFclJD4WG-LvuvrXW29NPwEAAP__bVhsBw) have taken the offer, according to officials. Monday's ruling is the [second extension of the program.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQRn-NvTk6zhjI4KELW7p2RAafwdEFR3Ckzb-v6N5v_aT3pPd1G24hc17nz_AgL6kMCOgMoKmqIYbM76HW0SciJKvJV629YosOnF48OroCpAZqex2rRGFCSrHtXJMSdhPo7E8aYHXOAV5grFuy02QD1U3XRVUDxSxlu9xLXmWhxO_you0ylYdmv4g8d2U_FPYKe1loycznp7DfaD44SC6rwn4qxyZmDCJMu8LeVbbpGjCJIm2Bzf2IMxn6EVrjbsbjXQ4xkULkvJLCXm8-Pr8zc96bVtUwP0L-E2n5L8rL428AAAD__8d_ZJ0) Unions have argued that employees might find themselves out of luck when government funding terminates in March, as Congress hasn't authorized the spending for the program. The pause is [expected to continue](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1u7CAUhJ8Gd1hwwH8FxW3c7W1TWhgOXlYYLGDX2Tx95KTOtN9oNPo-bstN--Dj9l_vqKpLCzDoKAPK-WK1D-9FNlY5REDRoOKDmGCAjnXNXY2TGUGKdUTTg4BBr9w63g1Oyn7SaBqvrjUG_ErHoGWrHFAYIzTKfhwtkQytrym3j-RjvaML7_TC3Jq0N0Hdaz0KEf8IzATm8zzbuJqIZ7k4gflIwVdvCoHZpqiDpTU_94PA_HjaDSl-Voy2UJcRv_AXFvqMR0aDFmNFS4-gI92w0t2H4FMs1KHFrAM9E80maj7xTkKTlT3Oq1L6gUi27dqHn5v1L20vBd8BAAD__xHJcmM) until the judge rules on a preliminary injunction in the case.
## President Pinches Penny Production
President Trump ordered the U.S. Treasury to [stop producing new pennies](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOtCAUhZ8GOwxccHQKir-xm7_d0iBcRjYIBq9jfPuN2--pTnKSLyff12t62Zhifv-3KxoKZQIBHRfApZy8jemadONNQARUDRrZqyf00ImuWYxzj_4ZANQ8uEFIr8Fq3QX5DP3gg3JNNDdNgLzTCWjFrHtUzimL-jEMnmmBPlKp7XeJmRYM6SofrK0ra5PMQrTtTP1jMDIYz_NsXZ7dPTIYbzSDUQCDUQoGI9Vj3biN684t8dPuhOFIfN8w-5jffL54qR7r3TF7ToVvmPPFt1r84SiW3C60pqYav50xpbg_eqbFe7Ux_T6ivwx9DPwEAAD__0YDaJA), citing the move as a way to reduce wasteful spending since each penny costs more to mint than it can buy. The U.S. Mint's 2024 fiscal report revealed that the penny costs [at least 3.7 cents to mint](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DFvwyAQBeBfgzcifBiTDAxdvKVrR4vAOb4WgwWXRPn3lbv3rU_6nvS-rvPVU6J8__QbOl7KDAqMVCD7fo6e0nseuugWREDdoeutvoAFo0y3unCzcBl1XMbFRgijt2B1NHAOejHBLB25Q1PQHzEKTuo2WNQhaI_DeD5HMSiMxKWevgtlXnFJ7_LEegpl65Jbmfcm9IeAScDEK66U0tEJmNayYcZXEzD5uFGmxtUzlSxgMr02RivJ9bHtMlLFwE1yRd8e9S25yMZll5v_oXyXO-ZMeEBddXF_UUrURisGdd88_e11_N83Twe_AQAA___l8GfA), marking the 19th consecutive year its production exceeded face value. The U.S. spent over $179 million to mint over 4.5 billion pennies in fiscal year 2023 alone. Previous attempts to [eliminate the penny](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71uhDAQBOCnsbtD9trGULhIQ3dpUyL_LLCRwRewjlyePiJ9phpppE-aj_t495Rpm9_9iq5OZQQB5ibgJuWYPOXXqHlyEyKg4uikVT1YMMLwxQXTp77zVlr0sbWmMxAkTGYCCJ31gZO7NAHyihHQiKAtqhiVR912XWJaYKJa9uaz0FYXnPKrPHFvYll5dkutj4OpNwYDg-E8zyaEeG0Mhg3Pg8Hg90ox41Wjnu23-kH9tRW-u_Q4KWc6Wsu0mFdP-U-t_718OvgNAAD__zRmU28) haven't been successful. Supporters argue that the coin helps keep prices lower and enhances charitable donations. Internationally, Canada hasn’t minted a one-cent coin since 2012. Not all pennies are equal; several editions are worth tens of thousands of dollars, including two pennies from the 1940s estimated to be over $1 million in value. [See valuable pennies here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uwyAURp_G3rDwxdjOwNAlW7p2tPi5JLfFgAwJyttX7t5v_nSOdL5u201ToHj_1Duq6tMGHCTjwMZxc5rCe5t6pzwioOhRjYu4wAKSy_6h8HLhzoyer9Mi3GqX2VtrpJGrn7UR0JM6aRzGc5LDwM20oLBWaJzmdXXdxNFRTcfwnSjWB_rwTi88Bpv2PqhHrbl04qODawfX1toQsZWG-HMeOrgGKpXtqVT20uGpTUCWMUbCwurx3DMrNeXC8pHc01ZKkQGHdZbQH8rlRiFQmZdu4vddU_iz1v8qvBT8BgAA__-h_WCa).

body:
These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkc2K2zAQgJ9GvtloRnbkHHwIOIaF3W3ZFHoUWmnWGZBlI8kpffsSSEqPPc4P88038_PNvFkOHOd3u9DAOZuUTbTmyiHUNjqmWGp_8wYldrXEGsBA5YcOof_qKxpAqyNqfeyhug69x0OntJZWEWjrjse21eCwd_Dpv0hWPNznSAQAaPuubTwejm0HVqP2n50F0cp987ZQwzGzp-zWddvWwIVdbtY0V2G4lrJloU4CJ4FTJrcn8s194-xtoIb8LnD6GwucniLumjgXtpHL77tVXZLlQEmoKTuhRik1wLvEFl-hG7-N5_NF4GEvi8nrnhwJNW5pzRu5wnF-lBbyvC9CjbRYDo-ks8tmeY5CjQ_4v2zjb_7ZuMZCsQg1_vg4vbyeP8z3U_1yudTPQ1Vp8NsvDoHzQYtWzndK49alKv_9r9uAfwIAAP__wlifdA)

| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyMkc2K2zAQgJ9GvtloRnbkHHwIOIaF3W3ZFHoUWmnWGZBlI8kpffsSSEqPPc4P88038_PNvFkOHOd3u9DAOZuUTbTmyiHUNjqmWGp_8wYldrXEGsBA5YcOof_qKxpAqyNqfeyhug69x0OntJZWEWjrjse21eCwd_Dpv0hWPNznSAQAaPuubTwejm0HVqP2n50F0cp987ZQwzGzp-zWddvWwIVdbtY0V2G4lrJloU4CJ4FTJrcn8s194-xtoIb8LnD6GwucniLumjgXtpHL77tVXZLlQEmoKTuhRik1wLvEFl-hG7-N5_NF4GEvi8nrnhwJNW5pzRu5wnF-lBbyvC9CjbRYDo-ks8tmeY5CjQ_4v2zjb_7ZuMZCsQg1_vg4vbyeP8z3U_1yudTPQ1Vp8NsvDoHzQYtWzndK49alKv_9r9uAfwIAAP__wlifdA)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

There’s a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/s/c/GaQxiMIijTm0HnDvKEiouzW0tFPh7vDMGtBI8n25T5qg2LtoYuqbfnxpObuuv4ewBEy2wokhIzLd1RaVnS9fIKZB2_Z4bzZSBP_H_4i0cYNu_WqnVHU7AEjVFeY1kdDnlirm8Mc4o4wYPsiITtR24j9puAcLAd7mgUO149ddU4zotgzDbtYAsxkiatz0pjGs2yXi92NXUjH9n1lLv0eQlKfH0ZeYR8W7Ryvs6Fm_Ebbhou6tl2BmbysyVGniT9-0nfeVwliabe-28ilf68nbQQrwJe3FfXMI268qzHJyqvuC3RRjMXAKVjSZeFmSJ8y_YfKgUivCIj6uTVMGMa-AGdkdXPVGfIIJNo935zYpejXEmoEHjI1s8LuEJunm1b6eb6w91t9RMn-FJ5SZEJlkWqgVDzTxg-5s7xZURfn0nNbFwGTNY3ggI70y-XcYffdjmVLnYgaE9oUc9J-IGeMvTg/G2ww2BEyOPVOG0lmr7bmaKjzZD4Q-9Uz/5)

| | Dear Friend,

There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it is...What is true about the world?

Tough, right?

It's a question mankind has asked since ancient times--since creation itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do, email me because I would love to know more!).

This question is especially pressing today because of the growing power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material world.

That's one of the reasons we released our free online course, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Why chemistry?

For one, this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to millions of Americans, including you.

More fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as humans in the world around us and reveals the framework, implications, and potential for human life.

Like all our courses, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry"** contains stunning visuals, study guides, quizzes, and in this case, hands-on experiments. This content is especially well-suited for science teachers, homeschool parents, or lifelong learners.

And our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

**For any donation of $100 or more, you will receive a beautiful DVD box set for "The Great Principles of Chemistry," by clicking the link below:

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/principles-of-chemistry](https://links.conservativesgive.com/s/c/jRkMskP-kxMCjwxS980SILlYT4EMXnOzNsfXU84986ibpqJ7cVCPrJEpmdcGfSCAdNN1UA0Y81d6aHjH0sSDIUUldhbZnga2x_NM6FxVBPZeU3mFacPz5iv9l0NE69s7kp5KP7z5-OPZG1MlHaEyC1848imO8ztF9180LeOochZczUr3BKLw40reR4iMhIjCnGSOp7agW-E6qDQiWF75GHCPtojXxLyWmMRJEb4tDkvzRn8yhYPH4UniwxNKaZE2OYxIuY1dewArBIU6ONirnM25wkteRSsbZWu8amH8SDS8rPLveg2fD3Lm_Ne2L8-uVFuISbLDc9z5Kh4RQAPJPp2qxi128KKZVbNa-RzvWVdOAV3Ft3XIODllaHzkPDcIlsi9dNc6FXgajJ79Mlo9V6hxdJTKj-cdUMdzI8eRIiC8YlJEr4KhMBRgafFg0YYFXDJP-MiS54uSj1WqJgKPhw/vXHLevE-HkPqkdTA8R5fmkvRsc2vWmpX/5)

The proper study of chemistry helps us understand the world and inspires wonder and awe at the beauty of creation and its Creator.

For these reasons, please join us in helping others gain a greater appreciation for the world around us with **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Let's promote what's true about our world together.

Warm Regards,

Bill Gray, ‘01

Hillsdale College

subject: Which came first: lighters or matches?
body:
Lighters seem, on the surface, to be a little more advanced than your standard pack of matches. [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68do8e1pz2e083t5af98ceifqtr1t91ruo8qputfzx7o8j0itfhxp5g2x5ezg9fu0pn9knb3trhsujwilodj7kapee9tzvuw1jv3qxoddr2f19dalfvxe2r5qacqkl534k1znlutqvejuo8py&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sripn0&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# [Lighters were invented before modern matches.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sripn0&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sripn0&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sripn0&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| L ighters seem, on the surface, to be a little more advanced than your standard pack of matches. But lighters were actually invented before matches as we know them today. Until the early 19th century, “matches” were flammable sticks made to [carry fire](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sripn0&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) from one place to another, not make fire on their own. Early self-igniting matches were too dangerous to be practical. The earliest, invented in 1805, involved dipping potassium chlorate into sulphuric acid. Another, created in 1816, was a sulfur-tipped match scraped inside a phosphorus-coated tube.
---
Some of the earliest lighters, meanwhile, [date back](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sripn0&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) to the 17th century and were modified versions of flintlock pistols, but instead of igniting gunpowder (and launching a bullet), they ignited tinder. In the 18th century, Italian chemist Alessandro Volta created an [“inflammable air”](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sripn0&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) (hydrogen) lighter that used water to force hydrogen past a striker, where it was lit by a spark. But Volta’s lighters required scientific knowledge to use. The Döbereiner’s lamp (also called a “tinderbox”), a table lighter invented in Germany in 1823, also used hydrogen gas, but could be used easily by anyone. More than 20,000 of these more practical lighters were sold that decade. Lighters, of course, continued to advance from there: Zippo lighters emerged in the mid-1930s, and Bic disposable lighters hit the market in 1973.
The first friction matches, which were tipped in potassium chlorate-antimony sulfide paste and ignited with sandpaper, were [invented in 1826](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sripn0&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). Phosphorus gained popularity in the 1830s, as did the widespread use of white phosphorus, a deadly chemical that led to the death and disfigurement of many match factory workers. Phosphorus sesquisulfide, a less toxic alternative, emerged at the turn of the 20th century, and it’s still in the classic Diamond Strike Anywhere matches we use today.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sripn0&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sripn0&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## Mirrors were used to start fires in ancient China.
You’ve probably heard of setting leaves on fire with a magnifying glass, and indeed people have been using this basic principle — concentrating sunlight into a small, focused point — to start fires for millennia. As far back as 3,000 years ago, concave mirrors made out of bronze called _yang sui_ were [used](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sripn0&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) to start fires in China. Chinese philosopher Confucius even wrote of boys attaching the mirrors to their belts when they got dressed so they could start fires later in the day.

## Bomb Threat Delays Flight
An American Airlines flight from Austin to Charlotte was delayed on Friday after a [custom WiFi hotspot](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGK9CAURp_GdAbvVWNSWPzwk262WZYtg0aTXDBxMDIzeftltt_2--BwON-36eYo0bF-uD3a-lryhAI1F8gBpuAoXZNqgvUiDNBEC0YOaAzoodlsL3r0fvBGiwGkX1SYQ6dBzkaHGYNqyL5hAgEA0ShscTFKgNa6lzIMemFKxEA1l7ZuscaXO5d05Ucs7Zz3Jtmt1vvJ5D-GI8PR-fmIz7Nd8_tmOH59vtc9FprdwR2VREc8-ZJo3SoPMbkrBu7z7nndSnSV4XjWXC4mRwpM_gfoOwWdwKbYcH9SSnR2himx7o7Sr0T9s8rD4k8AAAD__4M1YxE) named "There is a bomb on this flight” was discovered prior to takeoff. After being alerted to the suspected threat, the pilot returned the plane to the gate. A police officer boarded and warned passengers that a [full investigation would be conducted](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OwyAQBOCnwR0WLOxhFxTXuMu1V1qYn3gl_CNM4uTtT05_3UgjfSPN7228Ocq03n_cEm19pW0EAcgFcCnH4Ci_R90EO4nQyyZaaVQPxkjsm9k6paagfUSpPXpl0COqznuIvUuYYkP2wgRIKQGMhhaS0UIiYqdU6DExLWKgupW2zrHGlztSfm_PWFq_LU22c637wdQ3g4HBcJ5n6-eyrVfLYPCPXB8lMhhcqeTzlT4Id0ss5N3KHZVMazx4ynSfK5-2ZeIgJHZKd-0-702xYT8pZzq-DNPivjjKn_X67x1PC38BAAD__6pJYm4) unless the person who created the hotspot admitted it was a joke. When no one came forward, all passengers were escorted off for additional screening. The aircraft and luggage were [checked for explosives](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAURb8Gb1i8ZzBmYOjiLV07WhgeMSqOI0zs5O-rZO96r3R0dH4u08WlnG7Xb7eSrc-4TShQcYEcYAou5dckm2BnEQw0ZEF3BrUGZZrFqh5jZyLEnqKPaJSfhZTU96iDCWZokn3DBAIAopbYYtRSgFJq6LpgVGRSUEh1K21dqNLT7TG_toNK67e1yXap9b6z7ovhyHA8z7P9PR70PhmOrtTkMzEca3EHZYbjvK0zr0shV7l77DXduEvlvpXK3UolefcZcrrRzmNO16UyHLE3PBg_QJw97zx6LgEUHzwAnzWhh66nQcim2HA_U85p7zWT4rq6lD-m9d90h8W_AAAA__8_lm8K) with the assistance of a bomb-sniffing dog before police gave the all-clear. The flight, originally scheduled for a 1:42 p.m. departure, finally left at 6:51 p.m. and arrived in Charlotte without further incident.
## Fed: Tariffs Threaten Texas Job Growth
Economists at the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas [predict 225,000 jobs will be added to payrolls](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0zzGO6yAQgOHT4C7WzNiEUFC8xl1eu6U1gSFGwksEKE5uv8r2e4H_0_91Xa-ccvq-_-ddXH_FshKQPgGdENfAKb_XeQjuBsHiIA7NZMkY1HbYnBYbbmeUm_eeLwZhBgQNeLHIwGCH5D4xIEQkMjONFM0MqLW-TFOwOqoZJKRe6tg36fLiFvO7PKWOvuxDdlvvj6amf4oWRctxHGPgnLlFCWOpd0VLlSZc_aZoiaWK59YVLR9W0SL748ODGaoLjyPlnNrZqBnuO6f8a_Q_p5-OfgIAAP__0pVW6A) in Texas this year, a growth rate of 1.6% from last year’s total of nearly 14.2 million jobs. In 2024, employment increased by 1.7% from the previous year, down from 2.4% in 2023. The [annual economic outlook](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuKyEURL8GOiO4gDEFxZOe6Jw25YpdLl4U1liAvfbfR47Sphppipmj83meziGXfL18hA3deKY6AQd94HAQYoohl9ekaHQzj1ZQdMJIC8YIbenqNOgTqjks9gjK8FmdrDhKJUDOyBOXNLv3GAchBIBRwCAZxYXW-iRltDoRxTHmURsbKw58hp7Kqz6wsaVutLh1jFsn8h8BT8Dv-85iKCX0hJHVdiHgDwT8hjEHAv5_Xe4bXkcn4Bt2DG1ZCXh8_HZvmHfoeh-l1i92i4k2F297LiX3oyGKX7aQy8_7-FPHw8F3AAAA___bBF_H) was delivered at a meeting for business and community leaders last Friday. Senior economist Pia Orrenius said last year’s slowdown can be attributed to high interest rates, falling oil and gas prices, and uncertainty about the presidential election. Orrenius said the [biggest threat to growth](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FygzAQRL9G6mB0J8kXFSrS0DltSgYjyWgiOA8oBv99Bvfptth9O-_72l-HXPJy_xrm6OuRuEeFtlHYAPRhyOXVGxn8TQUHMnog7ZAIrJOT1xeTnEZCUJZIu1FFTaD1jUZ0wVxk9idMIQAgksEWExkF1toPrYOzSRgVQ668tnWKNR7DlsqLn3FtR55l8VOtj03oT4GdwG7f9zbxYZa4b2dBYHdGgd172sSRF57z2PBvLcw_zfkuVx8eey4lbxcSRt3nIZc3vv7r-_T4FwAA___QplYf) this year is tariffs, particularly on goods from Mexico, the state’s No. 1 international trading partner. She and her staff calculated a 25% tariff on trade with Mexico could impact Texas GDP growth by 15-30%. Still, she praised the Texas economy for being “flexible” and “market-driven” and acknowledged the prospect of deregulation and lower taxes provide business leaders reason to be optimistic.
## Texans Featured in Super Bowl
Texans were featured prominently during the Super Bowl, both on the field and in between the action. Eagles quarterback and Super Bowl MVP Jalen Hurts previously played for Channelview High School, and Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes played for Whitehouse High School and Texas Tech University. name: Elizabeth Nader
subject: Commit to vote in the primary
body:
Peter, We’ve been talking constantly about the opportunity the 2025 election offers us to take back Trenton from the lunatics
|
---
| Peter, We’ve been talking _constantly_ about the opportunity the 2025 election offers us to take back Trenton from the lunatics and finally restore sanity to our state. That’s well established. But... we don’t talk enough about the primary. The June election where we choose who from our party advances to the General Election in November for each of the offices on the ballot. If you don’t like your choices come November...well, you have the chance to influence that in June. The problem is this. **Only 22% of common sense New Jersey voters _actually vote_ in primaries. ** That’s roughly 2 in 10. That’s wayyyy too few. And it shows. You know who is voting in primaries? The elite. The power brokers. The people who don’t have a clue what we want – and even if they did, don’t care. So. I have one very simple request for you today.
---
| | [COMMIT to Vote for One Less Lemon in the June Primary. ](https://xtz223.keap-link004.com/v2/click/9cfc9c7970d41ed7219bbde97659c884/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnEVxtQ-8SYiI5iHqHKIDLenuso6Zif-9tcJTQdeZ532Gd0YgFIWgpIIA7vRgzAMLNJZccRS0k4KK8rVlK9_1XAtqLq6xlp2CYPwaXoB57K3Z1gIaFBrkeAh3aZLH5yzJU0OqQpsb_3n8DVs80T5MMpimn2JsOEU3424hIN3h3KjiphWddG34C5FqA8fp-96WAmts2xobKexSNo7p6xhHoRSK6vOAFIe3aXoCQ-Njxg==)
---
| We need as many of us common sense folks influencing those primary decisions, kicking out the lemons, and putting good people on the November ballot. Let’s overwhelm them with our vote. For New Jersey, Elizabeth Nader
---
|

body:
🇺🇸A voter mandate | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/88ec2ac2c880/n41kepo7ku-12730192?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=a073b6611b&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

__
We have a lot of evil in our world. But what is EVIL, actually? Does it float around like a virus - infecting? Does it rain down - drowning? Does it erupt from underground - enveloping?

Kinda yes. It does infect, drown, and envelope all.

But unique to evil is ... it needs a host. It needs a BELIEVER of evil to continue evil. It needs a BODY to infect, drown, and envelope all.

And further, evil needs a recipient. It needs to have a non-believer of evil to tempt, corrupt, and destroy.

Evil is chaos implemented by people. Without a host and without a NEW person turned to evil, the cycle fades and diminishes.

Which is why Romans 12:21 is so relevant, because conquering evil is pretty simple.

**Do Good.**

_"Remember, it is sin to know what you ought to do and then not do it."_
* * *
I had one of our strongest, smartest, most dedicated Republicans email me with a concern. I've considered many elements to the response and then I thought...what a great message for my morning coffee. So, I'm going to share the concern and a brief insight that I have that matches their concern.

>From a Patriot,
"_The hearing for LB89, Stand With Women, lasted over 10.5 hours with only 20 proponents testifying in support of Senator Kauth’s bill with over 100 opposition testifiers. This whupping ratio of 10 to 1 by opponents is going to make it extremely difficult to pass this important bill.

__It appears that: _
1. _Conservatives have dis-engaged because President Trump is creating conservative momentum with his Executive Orders_
2. _The momentum caused by President Trump has most conservatives focused nationally instead of on our state legislation_
3. _Most citizens don’t realize President Trump’s Executive Order can be easily reversed when the Democrats regain control of the White House in the future._

_One potential solution for GOP leadership to consider would be to double down communication to all GOP membe rs to ENGAGE in important Nebraska legislation by providing in-person and emailed testimony."_ My Insights...

The dis-engagement is due to many real life variables, but the email is correct in assessing two of those variables and both involve the impact that President Trump has.

1\. Executive Orders solve problems immediately. But expose ineffective legislative or governing bodies and their PERCEIVED limitations.
2\. National momentum can have a trickle down effect on legislation, BUT it doesn't STICK if local governing bodies don't act in similar fashion.

These two points are very astute and an accurate assessment of reality, but I don't think its the whole picture as to why conservatives are not "engaging" Committee hearings.

__**The most relevant and human EMOTIONS to disengagement is EXHAUSTION or COMPLETION.**__

I'll start with "completion". Voters are told in many different ways...just get Republicans elected! That's ALL you have to do. Consultants tell voters this. Politicians tell voters this. Leaders in the parties use this as the rallying cry during election season.

As I've said over and over again, our NEGOP Constitutional Objective is **"to maintenance the government of, by, and for the people AND to further our principles".** Just "getting Republicans elected" is a means, NOT an end. The END RESULT of our efforts should ALWAYS match the objective. We should be striving to "maintenance our government" WITH Constitutional and Platform Republicans. The core principles of these types of leaders will more than likely yield the best Republican results.

**Rightfully so, most voters believe the job is done**. _They elected Republicans._ 33 of them at the Unicameral. 4 of them at the Board of Education, 5 on the Public Service Commission, 4 UNL Regents, 4 State Officers (Auditor, Treasurer, Attorney General, Secretary of State), 5 Federal Officers, 1 Governor/Lt. Governor combo. _**That's 57 Republican elected representatives in the highest governing or law-making positions.**_ In a state with a 2:1 growing advantage of Republican voters to Democrat voters.

**The WORK should be done. Just like electing President Trump! 57 Republicans should at bare minimum EQUAL the efforts of ONE President Trump. **They were all elected on CAMPAIGN promises and I believe a mandate. EVERY election cycle is a MANDATE.

**Second Variable - EXHAUSTION.** Many of the same people who worked tirelessly over the last 12 months during elections, but even more so over the last 3-4 years TESTIFYING... are EXHAUSTED of testifying! Why should they have to repeat their MANDATE daily, weekly, monthly, yearly to MANY OF THE SAME leaders? And if they don't show up or email or call or text or write letters...there is this belief amongst some elected officials that maybe the constituents have changed their mind or no longer care?!?

**We have a fundamental flaw in our representative government if constituents must CONSTANTLY show up to remind elected officials of why THEY were elected over the other option.**

We have a fundamental flaw in our representative government if "The integrity of the INSTITUTION" has more voice than the people (For example...lowering the Cloture Threshold to 30 votes to match the Governor Veto).

We live in a perpetual circle of incrementalism. So, constituents reach a certain level of completion, exhaustion, apathy, and angst.

We are told to elect Republicans who know our expectations, but we need to show up to remind them of our expectations, but we don't understand the challenges of the Unicameral or what it's like there, but we don't realize the amount of special interests that have GREATER voices, but we need more Republicans elected, so elect more Republicans who know our expectations...and on and on it goes.

It's pretty simple to me...**DO GOOD!**
The truth shall set us free.
Blessings,

| –Chairman Underwood

As I've said over and over again, our NEGOP Constitutional Objective is "to maintenance the government of, by, and for the people AND to further our principles". Just "getting Republicans elected" is a means, NOT an end. The END RESULT of our efforts should ALWAYS match the objective. We should be striving to "maintenance our government" WITH Constitutional and Platform Republicans. The core principles of these types of leaders will more than likely yield the best Republican results. Rightfully so, most voters believe the job is done. They elected Republicans. 33 of them at the Unicameral. 4 of them at the Board of Education, 5 on the Public Service Commission, 4 UNL Regents, 4 State Officers (Auditor, Treasurer, Attorney General, Secretary of State), 5 Federal Officers, 1 Governor/Lt. Governor combo. That's 57 Republican elected representatives in the highest governing or law-making positions. In a state with a 2:1 growing advantage of Republican voters to Democrat voters. The WORK should be done. Just like electing President Trump! 57 Republicans should at bare minimum EQUAL the efforts of ONE President Trump. They were all elected on CAMPAIGN promises and I believe a mandate. EVERY election cycle is a MANDATE. Second Variable - EXHAUSTION. Many of the same people who worked tirelessly over the last 12 months during elections, but even more so over the last 3-4 years TESTIFYING... are EXHAUSTED of testifying! Why should they have to repeat their MANDATE daily, weekly, monthly, yearly to MANY OF THE SAME leaders? And if they don't show up or email or call or text or write letters...there is this belief amongst some elected officials that maybe the constituents have changed their mind or no longer care?!? We have a fundamental flaw in our representative government if constituents must CONSTANTLY show up to remind elected officials of why THEY were elected over the other option. We have a fundamental flaw in our representative government if "The integrity of the INSTITUTION" has more voice than the people (For example...lowering the Cloture Threshold to 30 votes to match the Governor Veto). We live in a perpetual circle of incrementalism. So, constituents reach a certain level of completion, exhaustion, apathy, and angst. We are told to elect Republicans who know our expectations, but we need to show up to remind them of our expectations, but we don't understand the challenges of the Unicameral or what it's like there, but we don't realize the amount of special interests that have GREATER voices, but we need more Republicans elected, so elect more Republicans who know our expectations...and on and on it goes. It's pretty simple to me...DO GOOD! The truth shall set us free. | | | | Dear friend, Donald Trump promised to put America first—but his actions are **devastating the next generation of leaders.** His push to shut down the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) and remake the federal workforce has thrown young professionals into chaos, forcing layoffs, hiring freezes, and shattered dreams for those who sought stable, impactful careers in public service. Thousands of young professionals, fresh out of school and eager to build meaningful careers in public service, are finding their dreams shattered. Many entered federal service with the promise of stability, benefits, and the opportunity to make a difference. Instead, reckless freezes on foreign aid funding have left them laid off, struggling to pay rent, **and scrambling to survive.** This is the harsh reality for thousands of early-career professionals. Trump's administration has targeted probationary hires and contractors for cuts, leaving them jobless and without a safety net. Programs like PEPFAR, which save lives and fight global HIV/AIDS, are now collateral damage in **Trump’s war on public service.** By dismantling USAID and gutting critical funding, Trump isn’t just hurting young workers—he’s sabotaging America’s role in humanitarian aid and diplomacy. Young people who accepted financial sacrifices for the chance to serve their country are being abandoned, forced to compete in an already saturated job market. Hi. I bet that's not what you were expecting on a big red hat these days

_(But don 't you worry, I'm about as pro-Trump as they come!)_

_My name 's Marlin Stutzman._ I'm a 4th-generation farmer raising the finest Wagyu cows this side of the Mississippi. When I'm not herding cattle and hauling hay, I'm fighting the good fight in the People's House.

I ran for office because the Democrats AND even some Republicans have stabbed farmers like me in the back for as long as I can remember.

Ask any farmer - they'll show you the scars.

**I swear elites in DC think meat and produce *magically appear* at Whole Foods - not because farmers devote their blood, sweat, and tears to their trade. **

That's how they can sleep at night knowing...
* China is buying up our farmland
* Democrats taxed us into oblivion
* Liberals want to replace beef with fake meat made from God knows what
* Politicians get rich at our expense
* We're left to pick up the scraps

My entire life is focused on bringing all that to a screeching halt. And the political class knows I can't be bought off or bribed. That's why they're mobilizing the powers-at-be to silence me so they can keep the gravy train rolling.

_And holding the line here will be tougher than a $3 steak._

Fellow American,

Thank you for standing with me in 2024 and helping me protect this great country we love.

The new year of 2025 is underway! With that comes all the planning for President Trump's inauguration, and we need to maximize the less than four years we have remaining with his fearless leadership.

| "Government efficiency, across all levels, is more than a slogan to me. Being responsible stewards of taxpayer dollars is one of the most important responsibilities entrusted to elected officials.

For far too long, corrupt politicians and unelected bureaucrats from both sides of the aisle have been abusing those they are supposed to serve for their own gain. I am very pleased to see President Donald Trump mirror my concerns and efforts to curb reckless spending at the federal level. While previous administrations wanted to hire more federal agents to investigate everyday Americans, this president has shown a commitment to finally hold the U.S. government accountable to the people it serves.

Malicious acts aside, the amount of money the federal government wastes in improper payments is astounding..."

Today’s Supreme Court is out of touch with everyday Americans.

From gutting voting rights and rejecting student loan forgiveness to overturning Roe v. Wade and common sense gun safety , the Court is on the wrong side of popular opinion.

We currently have Justices on the court who have been there for over 33 years. That’s 2 years before the World Wide Web became available to the general public, 9 years before GPS, and 15 years before the smartphone.

Sign if you agree: Term limits will restore credibility to the Supreme Court. It's about understanding the fundamentals - like Social Security, health care, savings strategies - and how to leverage those in your retirement plans. So, how well do you understand these building blocks of a secure retirement? To answer that question, take the 5-question quiz on retirement planning that I'm sharing in this month's Visual Insights Newsletter. **[Click here to take the 3-minute quiz now!](https://financeinsights.net/jB6PUmYxJuv3En3sjlYJLTADQzm?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)** Improving your retirement literacy can boost your confidence and help you make informed decisions about your financial future.1 Wherever you're starting from, there's always room to grow. Hello dear reader!
As of Tuesday, February 11, 2025, here's where things are at with some bills I'm working on:
1. **[Free Speech Protection (SB1001](https://substack.com/redirect/05296bc2-4659-4e59-b3ea-e7f2b60c1823?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)):** This bill ensures Idahoans can express themselves in public without the threat of frivolous lawsuits aimed at silencing them. It's passed the Senate easily and is awaiting a hearing in the House Judiciary Committee.

2. **[Health Freedom (No Masks HB32)](https://substack.com/redirect/a6570f72-0d29-42e2-b1b7-93096b1dc351?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) :** The government shouldn't control what people wear on their faces or what's administered to their bodies. This bill I'm runnign with Rep. Rob Beiswenger seeks to eliminate mask mandates in Idaho, passed the house EASILY, and is currently pending a hearing in the Senate State Affairs Committee.

3. **Secure Idaho's Economy:** Representative Jordan Redman have a bill to implement E-Verify in Idaho. This bill would mandate that Idaho businesses check the legal status of everyone they hire. It'll deter companies from hiring illegally, prevent illegal immigrants from applying, and punish those who knowingly hire illegal aliens. It's awaiting a hearing in the House State Affairs.

4. **[Make Elections Safe Again (SB1049)](https://substack.com/redirect/6f430a57-b318-49cc-9b54-bde22de9eeff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) :** This bill eliminates the personal voting affidavit, an election security loophole that allows Idahoans to vote without a photo ID. SB1049 is awaiting a hearing in the Senate State Affairs.

5. **[Hold Public Health Accountable (S1031)](https://substack.com/redirect/d367a0a2-e16b-4041-94be-a2c93a1b8e98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) :** This bill adds a layer of accountability to Idaho's Public Health Districts, which currently have the legal authority to _" do all things"_ concerning public health. No agency should have that much power. S1031 will have a full hearing on Tues 2/11/25 in the Senate Health and Welfare.

6. **[Adding Accountability to Idaho's H&W Department (S1052)](https://substack.com/redirect/de0cca8e-f48f-4bf3-88c6-695943bf8034?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):** The Department of Health and Welfare is the largest agency with nearly 3k employees and a $6 billion budget. It includes divisions like Medicaid and Behavioral Health, each containing various bureaus managing specific areas. Currently, all division heads serve at the pleasure of the director and must be approved by the board--this isn't true though for Bureau Chiefs. Some Bureau Chiefs oversee hundreds of employees and manage millions in funds (for instance, the Benefit Field Operations has 418 full-time positions, compared to the Department of Agriculture's 249). This bill aims to align bureau staffing with division standards to ensure accountability for Idaho taxpayers. SB1052 is awaiting a full hearing in the Senate Health and Welfare Committee.

7. **[Take the Power Back (HB90)](https://substack.com/redirect/b5ae6403-3138-4347-981e-dc5520c551eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) :** Representative John Vander Woude and I have a bill that takes power from the bureaucrats at the Idaho Department of Health and Welfare and gives it back to the people, mandating that any agreement the department enters into with the federal government must go through the legislature first. This eliminates their ability to work directly with the feds without involving the Idaho legislature. HB90 is awaiting a full hearing in the House Health and Welfare.

**Let 's make Idaho healthy again.**
**Let 's make Idaho safe again.**
**Let 's make Idaho bureaucrats accountable again.**
Cheers,
Brian

| | How do some folks stay active well into their 70's, 80's, and even 90's... enjoying all kinds of activities like hiking, gardening, and golfing...

...while others find themselves hobbling down stairs... or needing to rock back and forth just to get out of a chair?

Well, according to a new breakthrough discovery by Harvard University, scientists now know it comes down to a single mistake...

A mistake, that... when avoided, not only reverses joint discomfort and everyday aches... but can actually make joints healthier than they've been in years.

And here's the best part: avoiding this mistake is easy. There's just one problem...

Doing this defies common sense. In fact, it's so counterintuitive, a recent survey found that up to 77% of folks with sore joints are making this mistake every day because they think it's helping. When, in fact, it does just the opposite.

That's why when they stop making this mistake, their recovery can be quite dramatic.

To date, more than 180,547 people have tried this with life-changing results...

Ordinary folks who were once couch-bound are now walking a few miles per day again...

Others have resumed exercise classes they were once forced to give up.

And some have even started long-distance jogging after decades of sitting on the sidelines...

A Boston medical doctor recently recorded a short presentation which shows you this [#1 mistake and why you should avoid it at all costs](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJyMkc1unEoQhZ-m2TGiq6EbFix8Lxpl4WQRxbHIBhVdhelM82Noz5g8fQSyZuFVtp8-nTo6hcPsXbeVwvwnAHpHqwAQ6kEAvAX1E5-evi5b_FDXMr4p4J0L-P9DvcJdHi2-XG5v05TbYv31WH_5XqTfrvKuh23mu_xx9MQDOr9TU0VUpoCysxGX0qgCcl1oHfUloFWFLJgSA4ZtmuqONJExnBLluYxcCQlkCUgpM5kpdZJsWqMzQtuhwZREmhyHTt3CHHo3XnghdH472WmIfNmHMK9HsbOAc1jQXk49ow_99ntyY0BHuyngnGvVcmuyWOcJxmmOWdxK3cVsVW4NkaTCCHWePVoeeAxCVWtYcKShWSc_NZ8LNHtryARoJEdCVXJwa8ALN6uXOw4HJbewDW3zL1nN54hm9EdIVxfzn_r1ddMHPD6tKn5_f_7xWD1DtJQ035z3btVGpMnLsdg-0LWEvwEAAP__51StPQ). His video quickly went viral, racking up more than seven million views. And thousands of folks around the country are singing the praises of this method across social media.

Karen Potter from Tremont, Pennsylvania said, _"I can hardly believe it. I have been able to start back walking daily and I have not been able to do that in months and months."_

Kay Gilbert from Athens, Alabama wrote, _"I'm 73 and feel like running all over the place again. My kids say I outwalk them in Walmart."_

One of the strongest advocates for the Transit Oriented Development movement is DesegregateCT.

According to their website "DesegregateCT is a program of Regional Plan Association ("RPA"), a _**non-profit**_ that for 100 years has advanced ideas to improve economic health, environmental resiliency, and quality of life in the NJ-NY-CT region, and that has a century-long record of public engagement and service in Connecticut."
**What does New York Have to do With Connecticut?**
RPA is a NYC based non-profit with most of their board members based in NYC, NJ and to a lesser extent CT. Many of their board members are involved in various aspects of the real estate industry. RPA is located at One Whitehall Street, 16th Floor, New York, N.Y. 10004. It is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit.
According to its 2022 IRS filing it had a total revenue of $6,265,077 of which $3,861,665 was spent on salaries. The organization had net assets $5,918,125.
In 2022 RPA allocated $286,384 to DesegregateCT. The team is listed [here ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/90bde13e-df2c-4cba-9f15-0434ba118e6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

On line 4c of its Form 990 they state the following:
"DESEGREGATE CONNECTICUT - FOUNDED IN 2020, DESEGREGATECT HAS BEEN A PROGRAM OF RPA SINCE FEBRUARY 2022 AND IS DEDICATED TO ENACTING LAND USE REFORM AT THE LOCAL AND STATE LEVEL IN CONNECICUT TO ENCOURAGE ECONOMIC GROWTH, RACIAL EQUITY, AND ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY. IT OPERATES AS A COALITION OF NEARLY 80 NONPROFIT AND NEIGHBORHOOD GROUPS AND PROVIDES ORIGINAL RESEARCH EDUCATIONA OUTREACH AND ADVOCACY TO PASS LOCAL AND STATE LEGISLATION TO ENCOURAGE MORE DIVERSITY OF HOUSING OPTIONS, PARTICULARLY NEAR TRANSIT HUBS. IT IS SUPPORTED BY OPEN PHILANTHROPY AND SEVERAL LOCALLY BASED COMMUNITY FOUNDATIONS INCLUDING THE HARTFORD FUNDATION FOR PUBLIC GIVING." (In the most recent 990 for the Hartford Foundation they donated $25,000 to RPA)

According to the 2024 Annual Report of DesegregateCT (**which does not mention whether or not they are a non-profit, nor their connection to RPA)** they list a total expense of $294,555 and a revenue of $212,788. In its report it does mention any connection with RPA, nor any financial contribution from RPA to their budget. Interestingly the RPA 2022 contribution exceeded all of their reported income for 2024.

_**DesegregateCT clearly engages in lobbying for legislation.**_

According to the Greenwich Free Press in an article entitled "[5 Time's a Charm for Work Live Ride? Hearing on HB 6831 Set for Monday"](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f9464659-5c27-473d-8775-587d2f2ab2ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) \- WORK LIVE RIDE IS BACK.
The article goes on to state _" The bill, HB 6831, proposes to create affordable housing near public transportation hubs in Connecticut, including, for example, train stations and ferry terminals. This will be the fifth time that Desegregate CT has put forth their transit-oriented development bill."_

**Non-Profits can lose or should not have tax-exempt status due to political lobbying.**

According to the IRS,
* "In general, no organization may qualify for section 501(c)(3) status if a substantial part of its activities is attempting to influence legislation (commonly known as lobbying). A 501(c)(3) organization may engage in some lobbying, but too much lobbying activity risks loss of tax-exempt status".
* "An organization will be regarded as attempting to influence legislation if it contacts, or urges the public to contact, members or employees of a legislative body for the purpose of proposing, supporting, or opposing legislation, or if the organization advocates the adoption or rejection of legislation".
* "Organizations may, however, involve themselves in issues of public policy without the activity being considered as lobbying. For example, organizations may conduct educational meetings, prepare and distribute educational materials, or otherwise consider public policy issues in an educational manner without jeopardizing their tax-exempt status."
* _**DesegregateCT looks to be doing more lobbying than engaging in this educational carve out.**_

When you put it all together DesegregateCT is not an independent entity and does not file its own 990 tax returns. Desegregate CT Is a program of a larger organization (RPA), a New York City based 501(c)(3) charity (non-profit) who's program DesegrateCT is according to the Greenwich Free Press is proposing and advocation for legislation in Connecticut.

**This appears to be a violation of the IRS rules for nonprofits.**
**WHAT SHOULD BE DONE?
** We need to shed light on what DesegregateCT really is and who is behind it. It would be appropriate for the IRS to investigate the activities of DesegregateCT to determine if their lobbying efforts are in violation of the laws governing 501(c)(3) nonprofit corporations.
**WHAT DOES NEW YORK HAVE TO DO WITH CONNECTICUT?**
The better question is - Why is a NYC based public charity, through the guise of a specially created program called "DesegregateCT", heavily engaging in lobbying the Connecticut Legislature to change its laws regarding real estate development near transit stations in Connecticut? - There is a saying in Latin - **Cui bono?** \- in English "to whom is it a benefit?"

We are also entitled to know if there are board members of RPA who would profit if HB 6831 were to pass. We also need to know what developers, contractors, vendors, etc would benefit from these windfalls.

**The public and the legislature need to know the answers to these questions - This is the real transparency that we must demand.

Peter, Jonathan Nez said I could reach out with some exciting news, Peter: Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico — my home — to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here. I’m humbly asking: [**Will you join us as a day-one donor by donating just $3 or more to my campaign and Jonathan Nez****now?**](https://clicksp.jonathannezforaz.com/f/a/eWGqp46yejT67oU4yPCfVw~~/AAPPABA~/Opjt0MnuDfKb1EsykseCvvStd2vM0HbtZdkX7KpQqV7sA0xw87F2cJCbo1wzsOc0AlEFMcFRUcxD2K7pZ0zlK-2lkt5C6YuXFQ4PJ3vcthmpR7TvCl3Ji7LEe_IODRujqXw3NJoiEM4n5vyEHRRPstf27W5GGVQcX4NLYSaEWYr5CUwoEoHuIKJEm-mn5fLbzSBCcNNs9CyNcIMgwqIwPiu4dPoqUgtLOjasgoT_XDqq-JQy6EL_iX6MxQBXUcCuVymBeuwl7gbnrjnvuAereiHdXr98_bYpPHQgytTXqI5CkQUBDvJ7e0Rb6lnHbtPZjn5pEiLH3upoYIGY7EpdMpnmgsPX74X5gJl_bMLjpIO2TdqTsulkRvm7RcbSzVhnQJ8Y2hRj4FOu0-dFdl_gTtRDZfXnl9mG8DSRlN6CElUPfhNuzwfp69N2YIxWwK9rte3Oe4HnXZfZda5LTstdx9KxtnKCkE4xeB50btHtmVg~) The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve. My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agriculture tradition that still continues today. I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him. I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.) I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington. I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us – strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope. These are my stories. These are stories of New Mexico. These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children. The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit? I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation? We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure _everyone_ shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities. I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children. [**Will you join us with a day one donation, split between my campaign and Jonathan Nez****?**](https://clicksp.jonathannezforaz.com/f/a/eWGqp46yejT67oU4yPCfVw~~/AAPPABA~/Opjt0MnuDfKb1EsykseCvvStd2vM0HbtZdkX7KpQqV7sA0xw87F2cJCbo1wzsOc0AlEFMcFRUcxD2K7pZ0zlK-2lkt5C6YuXFQ4PJ3vcthmpR7TvCl3Ji7LEe_IODRujqXw3NJoiEM4n5vyEHRRPstf27W5GGVQcX4NLYSaEWYr5CUwoEoHuIKJEm-mn5fLbzSBCcNNs9CyNcIMgwqIwPiu4dPoqUgtLOjasgoT_XDqq-JQy6EL_iX6MxQBXUcCuVymBeuwl7gbnrjnvuAereiHdXr98_bYpPHQgytTXqI5CkQUBDvJ7e0Rb6lnHbtPZjn5pEiLH3upoYIGY7EpdMpnmgsPX74X5gJl_bMLjpIO2TdqTsulkRvm7RcbSzVhnQJ8Y2hRj4FOu0-dFdl_gTtRDZfXnl9mG8DSRlN6CElUPfhNuzwfp69N2YIxWwK9rte3Oe4HnXZfZda5LTstdx9KxtnKCkE4xeB50btHtmVg~) I would be honored to have your support. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us – strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope. These are my stories. These are stories of New Mexico. These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children. The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit? I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation? We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure everyone shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities. I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children. ~ I would be honored to have your support. Many thanks to Jonathan Nez for helping spread the word. I hope you’ll join us, Peter! Tim Kaine said I could reach out with some exciting news, Derek:
Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico — my home — to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here.
I’m humbly asking: Will you join us as a day-one donor by donating just $3 or more to my campaign and Tim Kaine's Common Ground PAC now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ms-dh-em-kainecgp]
The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve.
My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agriculture tradition that still continues today.
I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him.
I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.)
I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington.
I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us – strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope.
These are my stories.
These are stories of New Mexico.
These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children.
The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit?
I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation?
We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure everyone shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities.
I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children.
Will you join us with a day one donation, split between my campaign and Tim Kaine's Common Ground PAC ? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ms-dh-em-kainecgp] I would be honored to have your support.
Many thanks to Tim for helping spread the word. I hope you’ll join us!
Be fierce,
Deb

When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families. Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! name: Ilhan Omar
subject: The Palestinian people will remain in Gaza
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
Trump and Netanyahu’s proposed plan to forcibly relocate Palestinians and have the US occupy Gaza is morally repugnant and despicable. It’s ethnic cleansing
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1505%2E791427%2EDGq0LS)

[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/3098?t=2&akid=1505%2E791427%2EDGq0LS)
**Friend — The Palestinian people will remain in Gaza.**
Trump and Netanyahu’s proposed plan to forcibly relocate Palestinians and have the US occupy Gaza is morally repugnant and despicable. It’s ethnic cleansing.
And beyond that, this plan has no support among the international community, and I am confident that it will get no support from the American public.
Americans don’t want to see our troops sent to fight and die in another indefinite occupation in the Middle East, and certainly not for the sole reason of appeasing far-right leaders in the Israeli government and violent settlers who have played the biggest role in blocking any potential for peace in Israel and Palestine.
**The Palestinian people have called this land home long before the events of the last two years. They have called this land home long before 1948. The Palestinian people will remain in Gaza.**
It’s now the responsibility of anyone who believes in dignity and freedom for Palestinians; anyone who believes in the need for international law; anyone who opposes hatred and violence, to make their voice heard.
**[Add your name to our petition telling Congress to hold the line on Gaza. Our leaders shouldn’t sit back while Donald Trump helps Benjamin Netanyahu carry out a plan of ethnic cleansing.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-feb25-gaza/?source=em250211-1-120&akid=1505%2E791427%2EDGq0LS)
**[SIGN ON NOW](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-feb25-gaza/?source=em250211-1-120&akid=1505%2E791427%2EDGq0LS)**
Donald Trump’s proposals would be a disaster for human rights and the promise of peace in Palestine. We must oppose it with everything we have.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar
