name: Deb Haaland
subject: I’m running
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2242%2E135344%2ENvhlQ5)

Elissa said I could reach out with some exciting news:
Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico -- my home -- to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here.
I’m humbly asking: [**Will you join us as a day-one donor by donating just $5 or more to my campaign and Elissa Slotkin now?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ms-dh-em-slotkin.GVKrCI&refcode=em250211-1&t=2&akid=2242%2E135344%2ENvhlQ5)
The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve.
My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agriculture tradition that still continues today.
I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him.
I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.)
I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington.
I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us -- strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope.
These are my stories.
These are stories of New Mexico.
These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives -- and we want even more for our children.
The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit?
I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation?
We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure _everyone_ shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities.
I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children.
[**Will you join us with a day one donation, split between my campaign and Elissa Slotkin? I would be honored to have your support.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ms-dh-em-slotkin.GVKrCI&refcode=em250211-1&t=3&akid=2242%2E135344%2ENvhlQ5)
Many thanks to Elissa Slotkin for helping spread the word. I hope you’ll join us!
Be fierce,
Deb

Folks,
On his first day in office, President Donald Trump issued an executive order ending birthright citizenship , an order that a Reagan-appointed judge called “ blatantly unconstitutional .” Now, dozens in the House of Representatives are co-sponsoring H.R. 569, which would also deny citizenship to children of non-citizens.
Birthright citizenship has been the law of the land since the Supreme Court ruled in US v. Wong Kim Ark that the Constitution granted citizenship to American-born children without a citizen parent.
Ending automatic citizenship for people born in the United States is the beginning of a slippery slope where citizenship and our rights could be denied to any of us. It's too dangerous to even contemplate further.

I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him.

I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. These are my stories.

The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit?

I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation?

We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure everyone shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities.

I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children.

name: Deb Haaland
subject: I’m launching my campaign
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico.
#

Ruben Gallego said I could reach out with some exciting news, Peter:
Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico — my home — to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here.
I’m humbly asking: [**Will you join us as a day-one donor by donating just $3 or more to my campaign and Ruben Gallego now?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-haaland-split-ms-dh-em-gallego.CI94pf&refcode=em250211-1-60&t=1&akid=3709%2E734936%2EjZHf_7)
The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve.
My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agriculture tradition that still continues today.
I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him.
I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.)
I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington.
I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us – strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope.
These are my stories.
These are stories of New Mexico.
These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children.
The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit?
I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation?
We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure everyone shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities.
I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children.
[**Will you join us with a day one donation, split between my campaign and Ruben Gallego?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-haaland-split-ms-dh-em-gallego.CI94pf&refcode=em250211-1-60&t=2&akid=3709%2E734936%2EjZHf_7) I would be honored to have your support.
Many thanks to Ruben for helping spread the word. I hope you’ll join us, Peter!
Be fierce,
Deb

Photo of gavel, by **Phanphen Kaewwannarat**
### I hope I'm wrong
On Sunday, Feb 9, 2025, on Bluesky, I timidly asked, "[I hope I'm wrong, but it looks like they are trying to get rid of the judiciary. Hitler set up Special Courts. Can we stop another Hitler](https://substack.com/redirect/40701895-b92a-4a14-ad70-d82f8ab8a52e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?" That was in response to JD Vance's post on X, "Judges aren't allowed to control the executive's legitimate power."
On Feb 10, 2025 we learned that a federal judge in New Hampshire has[ ruled that the White House has violated his order](https://substack.com/redirect/6ecc4800-05e6-43cb-b9f8-7afff6ef6c9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to unfreeze billions of dollars in federal grants.
In response, again on Bluesky, I posted: "[One week or two?...til they either freeze the judiciary altogether, or else keep the loyalist judges and establish Special Courts](https://substack.com/redirect/e1cfb538-f8d1-4985-a8b2-fd82610d0398?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
### How many lawsuits can we file in three weeks?
There are some [40 lawsuits that have been filed](https://substack.com/redirect/cf9eb797-b088-46e0-b2b9-402f23b88fb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in opposition to Trump administration orders in the last three weeks. Jamie Raskin is now calling for a class-action suit filed by all Americans pursuant to the 1986 [Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA).](https://substack.com/redirect/26c90503-3997-438c-aeda-e07678550c5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Good luck with that, Congressman.
While I believe Democrats and organizations who have been harmed by the executive orders are right to pursue legal remedies, judicial action lacks immediacy. **Judicial remedy in the case of data theft has always presented a conundrum in that irreparable harm is done once the data has been accessed and disseminated.**
### Musk is fearless and undeterred
And yet, Musk & The Musketeers work on, seemingly fearless and undeterred. (Note: Contrary to offering the opportunity to verify information that was posted on Bluesky, I will not hyper-link to X out of respect for many readers' desire to not affiliate with Musk's social media platform.) On February 10, 2025, on X, Rep. Dan Goldman posted: "It wasn't just a freeze on @elonmusk and @DOGE accessing American's personal data. He was ordered to DETROY any data they already took. Elon must confirm he has followed the court order."
NJ Attorney General Matt Platkin commented on Goldman's post: "To be clear: the Judge ordered Elon and the DOGE bros to delete any data they illegally acquired since Trump took office. We are going to make sure they comply..."
Elon Musk then commented: "We don't have any personal data of Americans, you corrupt moron."
Dan Goldman: "Tell it to the judge under oath."
### They aren't just trying to sell your personal data to Amazon, ya know
Elon may be telling the truth. It is possible that they no longer have the data. It may have already been transmitted to god knows who or where.
So what's the rush? Why not just wait for the wheels of justice to grind at their own pace?
Answer: we don't have the luxury of time.
**According to reports in[The Washington Post](https://substack.com/redirect/d492b931-6ebd-4ad7-9744-d0c30253f2d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and in [The Hill](https://substack.com/redirect/01151867-ede3-44d6-a7fd-c3ed102eddfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the purpose for accessing the data in various governmental agencies is to teach AI generative software the information and processes so that humans and entire governmental departments will be replaced en masse.**
### Musk is using the information to teach AI systems how to replace our human workforce
While we wait for court orders, and wait longer for Musk's compliance with court orders, our entire government is rendered unrecognizable as it is being re-ordered under an authoritarian and non-human regime.
On Bluesky on Feb 7, 2025, when Florida Congressman Maxwell Frost noted that guards were denying entry to the Department of Education by members of Congress, Elon Musk replied: "No such department exists in the federal government."
My point: A judicial order is a piece of paper, at best. (Technically, in the year 2025, it is an electronic transmission that could be printed if desired.) A court order is apparently irrelevant in the face of Musk's ongoing technological terrorism. We are waiting for a bully's compliance with court action while congressionally-approved departments are quickly being annihilated and a total restructuring of our government's workforce is carried out.
### They have worked for decades to get the courts to line up on their side
The next step, as I see it, is to simply dispose of the distraction of the 40-something lawsuits and their potentially pesky orders. Why not simply take over the courts so that they can get the rulings they want?
The takeover of our court systems has been contemplated for decades. The most blatant display was the refusal by Mitch McConnell to even consider an Obama nominee to the Supreme Court when Scalia died. Since then there have been three Republican-appointed justices (Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, and Barrett). Though Biden appointed a total of 228 judges to district and appellate courts, but that number will likely be eclipsed when Trump begins adding to the 226 he appointed in his first term. Source: [Pew Research](https://substack.com/redirect/51676945-a276-4e9a-8d73-a5f5b67f23f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Along the way we have seen an erosion of precedent at the Supreme Court level, notably in the rulings on abortion. And with the SCOTUS gift on the powers of immunity granted to the president, all of what is going on is entirely legal. The Trump administration, with the court's blessing, can do all of what has been done.
But as we see, even though Trump has tried to pack the courts to the best of his ability, the appointment of hundreds of hand-picked judges is not an iron-clad guarantee of favorable rulings. **We must begin to contemplate that Trump will seek extra-judicial remedies if he continues to hit rulings like those handed down on the birthright citizenship case and in the judicial order to pause the freeze on federal funding.**
### Hitler's Special Courts
Will Trump go the route that Hitler did, and establish a parallel court system that co-exists with the established system until an eventual point at which there is a overt realignment with MAGA idealogy?
"Hitler determined to increase the political reliability of the courts. In 1933 he established special courts throughout Germany to try politically sensitive cases. Dissatisfied with the 'not guilty' verdicts rendered by the Supreme Court (Reichsgericht) in the [Reichstag Fire](https://substack.com/redirect/40835eb6-86b0-4f97-b5fc-94670caac7de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Trial, Hitler ordered the creation of the People's Court (Volksgerichtshof) in Berlin in 1934 to try treason and other important "political cases." Under [Roland Freisler](https://substack.com/redirect/4d356520-f4d7-44bd-a93a-7752d17bff7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the People's Court became part of the Nazi system of terror, condemning tens of thousands of people as "Volk Vermin" and thousands more to death for "Volk Treason." Source: ["Law and Justice in the Third Reich", from The Holocaust Encyclopedia.](https://substack.com/redirect/37d75bc6-2062-4aa0-8d78-3a8faab94f1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### Do you give it one week or two?
We've not even logged a full month since Trump's inauguration. Do you give it one week or two before we start to see him set up a parallel judiciary that gives him reliable rulings to quiet the naysayers?
But seriously - I hope I'm wrong.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democrat who ran in New York's 21st Congressional District in November 2024. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. _

body:
Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico.

Gabe Vasquez won the most competitive Democratic seat in Congress in 2022. He's running to be a champion for working families and build an economy that benefits everyone. If you’d like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/lNYIdkhPikOBrh6RGc-KWg2?unsubscribedata=9TA980YggLzjfrHdo0F%2FxlSEbt8rCwogEKWODhAOC4e4ysPGwvE9lSEuwqAE9cn2LCRNLcmaL87VPfFMQrQHdRJRZ9ZW7cqQ5IbeIzpQashvSt%2FMQ1ruBJ75PTKddnue81lrF0Hk9i%2BFYz0B8CbgaK0nIayas7UnEABTeK%2BNZDacwjqJlb8BiU4HAoveJYmR5BS%2FaHqEC18aueeRp%2F7WS1BG3tjxyHMlhcPWI%2BAXasjopf3LcIP5NLd0cJwDk3YGCsHdunXSK01lgRa2%2BUJEJ1rRaFJSfs0p8BN5zKH91CUlbuUdU3cfBcP6%2BZk8oxgkXmvRwjKipyEXf7DgcoyMGNQBtwYLTq%2BFC2IW3EkY9p%2FtUfb0zn70aYbnMSgsfHk3Hk8a5vwTFL8mco%2FUIltrP4WxnsnJpE2id1QNMGBt9%2FM%3D)
---
| | Gabe said I could reach out with some exciting news: Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico — my home — to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here. I’m humbly asking: [Will you join us as a day-one donor by donating just $3 or more to my campaign and Gabe Vasquez now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101941728/527566600/-173865004?amount=3&source=SBD_VASQUEZ_FR_021125_1_1_Haaland&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MDE3MzQ5ZS05OGU4LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sIk9WXOqeYDAGXT4hD-RZpnyGLul6up-CiIUpnwfuGQ=) The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve. My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agriculture tradition that still continues today. I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him. I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.) I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington. I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us — strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope. These are my stories. These are stories of New Mexico. These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children. The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit? I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation? We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure everyone shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities. I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children. [Will you join us with a day one donation, split between my campaign and Gabe Vasquez? clean_body: Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico. Gabe Vasquez won the most competitive Democratic seat in Congress in 2022. He's running to be a champion for working families and build an economy that benefits everyone. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | Gabe said I could reach out with some exciting news: Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico — my home — to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here. I’m humbly asking: = The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve. My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agriculture tradition that still continues today. I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him. I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.) I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington. I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us — strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope. These are my stories. These are stories of New Mexico. These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children. The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit? I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation? We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure everyone shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities. I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children. = Many thanks to Gabe for helping spread the word. I hope you’ll join us! # [](https://act.robbonta.com/go/3?refcode=em20250211&t=1&akid=1633%2E1088799%2ETNu13V)
Donald Trump is trying to unlawfully slash funding for public and medical health research at institutions across the country and in California that are working every day to cure diseases like cancer and Alzheimer's.
So, I filed another lawsuit against the Trump administration—within hours a judge granted our Temporary Restraining Order.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250211?refcode=em20250211-1633&refcode2=1633_1088799_TNu13V&akid=1633%2E1088799%2ETNu13V)

As this administration tries to defund our public institutions and put the future of healthcare research at risk, I will stand up for the extraordinary, forward-thinking work being led by scientists, medical professionals, and other dedicated workers.

body:

_February 11th, 2025_
---
| | |

**SHOCKING REPORT:
** **CHINA ATTACKS U.S. WATER SUPPLY**
---
---
**_FBI's Urgent Warning Has Been All Over The News_** Chinese hackers are coming for the water supply in your hometown. Attacking city water systems, biding their time and waiting for China's signal to strike. Experts warn that Russia and Iran are also targeting attacks on our city water systems. Overflowing, damaging and poisoning the lifegiving systems that we trust to keep us safe. Like it or not, your local tap water may be our country's weakest link. Deteriorating infrastructure. Systems years beyond their expiration dates. Negligent corporations. And God-knows-what in the water we drink. We're up against arsenic, plastics, chlorine, forever chemicals, hormone-altering drug residue and a host of other contaminants. Listen, I'm not trying to be the messenger of doom... **But protecting the water supply in your home is more important than ever.** If you don't take steps to be prepared, you and your family could end up vulnerable. Forced to choose between drinking poisoned, toxic or dirty water, or going without water altogether. It sounds harsh... But the truth is that even good people with good intentions can make serious mistakes. Mistakes like... **Getting filters that claim to purify your water, but don't prove it.** If a company doesn't have certifications from a third-party lab, show lab tests or reveal how many gallons were tested... that's a bad sign. After a couple gallons, most water filters on the market stop working for scary contaminants and start passing them into your water. **Getting bottled water with a 2-year shelf life and risking plastic leaching into your supply.** Not to mention all the money you'll waste, and the work required to carry cases of water. Plus with bottled water, you never really know what's been filtered out. **Or simply using a pitcher in the fridge... with slapshot filtration power and limited capacity.** Most pitchers hold a couple cups of water at a time. Not nearly enough to drink, cook and clean in an emergency. You'll run out in no time, just when your life depends on it. Well we have great news to share... Folks have been calling... Folks have been emailing... Folks have been leaving Facebook messages asking about our just-released... **NEW AND IMPROVED...** [**The Ultimate Water Filtration System!**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20264/6374453/8d1ee57fbc73de410a6d1ac517b59f1aa0f623da/beb6d81e9082af25671cbcaf0ccd9ca1a0b5139a)
---
[](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20264/6374453/76ac64386a51b10e41fb13eb134a62aabc38d27e/beb6d81e9082af25671cbcaf0ccd9ca1a0b5139a)
---
**But hurry – we have limited stock, and these Ultimate Water Filtration Systems are first-come first-served. We only have a small number of units to go around.** [**Get Your Ultimate Water Filtration Systems Rushed To You At This Special Pricing Plus All Your FREE Bonuses While Supplies Last!**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20264/6374453/8d1ee57fbc73de410a6d1ac517b59f1aa0f623da/beb6d81e9082af25671cbcaf0ccd9ca1a0b5139a) The best part is... **_This advanced filtration technology filters the nastiest, filthiest, bacteria-riddled and parasite infested water using no chemicals, no electricity and no moving parts!_** It's powered by the same technology that the U.S. Military and NASA trust to filter their water. But now available for you in your home. You're among the first to get access to these advanced, carbon-block water filters designed to filter water on your countertop at a sub-micron level without power or water hookup. **So you can reduce...** Harmful Bacteria – up to 99.9999%
Life-Threatening Viruses – up to 99.99%
Disease-Carrying Cysts – up to 99.9% Plus, this table-top unit targets 140+ dangerous contaminants from your tap water, including bacteria, viruses, toxic chemicals, arsenic, heavy metals, pharmaceuticals, VOCs and more. All in the same, best-selling system thousands of Americans trust in their homes. **The NEW & improved Filtration System may look the same...** But on the inside, these proprietary filters pack an even bigger punch than before. They're MORE reliable and easier to replace, too. So you get safer, cleaner water for you and your family. **But we have very limited stock, and we've been sold out of this filtration powerhouse for a while.** In fact, it's been a very long while. Months and months, actually. [**Now we've just got a fresh batch in.**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20264/6374453/8d1ee57fbc73de410a6d1ac517b59f1aa0f623da/beb6d81e9082af25671cbcaf0ccd9ca1a0b5139a) And if you need to take it with you? No problem. You're not tied to it like a whole-house filtration system. That kind of thing won't do you any good if you need to bug out. **And YES there's a payment plan!** Yes, right now, you can get your Ultimate Water Filtration Systems on a convenient, no-credit-check payment plan. We know you're good for it. You'll have the **peace of mind** knowing that you're doing everything you can to keep your family safer, by securing your Ultimate Water Filtration Systems today for fresher, cleaner water for years to come. [**Get Your Ultimate Water Filtration Systems Rushed To You At This Special Pricing Plus All Your FREE Bonuses While Supplies Last!**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20264/6374453/8d1ee57fbc73de410a6d1ac517b59f1aa0f623da/beb6d81e9082af25671cbcaf0ccd9ca1a0b5139a) To your survival, Frank Bates
Patriot Headquarters P.S. Derrick loves the convenience of his Ultimate Water Filtration System: _"It was so easy to install. Within minutes we had water that tasted so good, we couldn't believe it. We don't like the chlorine in tap water and we got tired of lugging around cases of bottled water."_ **Customers Love Their Ultimate Water Filtration System!**
---
---
**Cyndi L.**
"No question... beats the competition. After reviewing several other companies and seeing that I was not the only one thinking this way, as everyone was sold out of products, I decided to go with 4Patriots. They seem to be good people who are very helpful and their products seemed above average to others." **Michael B.**
"Saves me a ton of money and grocery-store headaches. During the pandemic, water wasn't always available. Not so with the Purifier. We love it and I have 5 gallons of water on hand all the time." **Faith P.**
"Water you can actually trust. This is so much better than storing gallons and gallons of bottled water. This enables us to make existing, natural water sources drinkable. I feel really good knowing that in an emergency situation, we'd be able to filter our water." **Carol B.**
"Stop worrying about what's in the water! We use our system for drinking and cooking but you can use it almost anywhere. It's easy to use and it doesn't take long to filter. The water tastes pure and delicious." **Rick O.**
"Easiest way to upgrade your drinking water. We chose this one because it handles everything and it's affordable. You never know when things will go out on you." **Thomas P.**
"Finally, I don't have to keep refilling my pitcher all day. I'm very happy with my water filter. Not only does our water now taste good (it tasted dirty from the tap) but the large capacity tank means I'm not refilling small pitchers repeatedly during the day." | | Right now, I'm on the frontlines of the fight to defend Oregonians from Donald Trump's dangerous, harmful policies and executive orders and Elon Musk's incursion into our federal agencies. Since Trump's inauguration, I've:
* Rallied with Americans at the Treasury to fight back against Elon Musk's egregious power grab and seizure of sensitive Treasury data, including Social Security and Medicare payment systems
* Led Democrats on the Budget Committee in a boycott of the behind-closed-doors business meeting moving Russ Vought, Trump's dangerous pick to be the Director of OMB, to the full Senate for a vote
* Organized a press conference and my colleagues to hold the Senate floor overnight to oppose Russ Vought's confirmation vote
* Sent a letter to Secretary of State Marco Rubio demanding public answers on the gutting of USAID
* Demanded reinstatement of fired Inspectors General
* Continued to vote against Trump's corrupt nominees; I won't vote for another nominee or motion to proceed to a bill until this Constitutional crisis is over

And, I've been traveling across Oregon holding town halls, talking to Oregonians, and reading your messages. Here's one question I've been asked over and over: "What can I do to help combat Trump's dangerous MAGA agenda?" **My answer is this: You're already doing it.**
* When you fight his illegal program cuts, his unqualified appointees, or MAGA legislation by calling your representatives, you're showing your power
* When you volunteer and get involved with a local progressive organization to ensure our communities are taken care of and that we have strong Democrats up and down the ballot, you're showing your power
* When you magnify your voice by joining an advocacy organization like Indivisible, MoveOn, or Working Families Party or a group that organizes around an issue you care about, like Planned Parenthood for reproductive health or Sunrise or 350.org for climate issues, you’re showing your power
* When you donate to a cause or campaign that directly fights Trump's dangerous, destructive agenda, you're showing your power

The most important thing you can do to ensure we stop Trump's agenda is this: Elect more Democrats up and down the ballot in your next election. That means getting involved in your local school board races, your city and county council races, your state Supreme Court elections, and your Congressional races. Having one more progressive, Democratic elected official in office is one more person we can count on to stop Trump's agenda. We have a lot to do together to win the battle, but what I know is that this team won't back down from the fight. body:
Help Fair Fight continue to fight for our freedoms |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101943103/527571364/1793776944?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250211_f_BlackHistoryMonth_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDI5OGQzMy05YWU4LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yo-tKURHFKA0rOW2HaCIGsce_bul-99gsvne7y6cyD4=&emci=17798e93-89e8-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=d0298d33-9ae8-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=1037277)

| | Team Fair Fight strongly believes that Black history is American history. During February, and throughout the year, we strive to honor the rich culture, resilience, and enduring legacy of the Black community. One of the key elements of the Civil Rights Movement was the fight for voting rights. During the Jim Crow era, literacy tests, poll taxes, and violent intimidation prevented Black people from exercising their right to vote, especially in Southern states. White lawmakers were desperate to stop communities they viewed as undesirable voting blocs from wielding power at the ballot box. The Voting Rights Act of 1965 was a hard-fought victory owed to years of tireless activism and unyielding bravery by Civil Rights leaders determined to put an end to Jim Crow voter suppression and the centuries-long disenfranchisement of Black voters in the United States. **Take a moment to recognize the trailblazers who fought for justice and freedom, and who helped pave the way to make real the promises of democracy.** | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101943107/527571407/-1125869122?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250211_f_BlackHistoryMonth_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDI5OGQzMy05YWU4LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yo-tKURHFKA0rOW2HaCIGsce_bul-99gsvne7y6cyD4=)
---
Congressman John Lewis represented Georgia's 5th congressional district from 1987 until his death in 2020. He was a major force in the Civil Rights Movement, as a Freedom Rider, chairman of the Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee, and one of the organizers of the March on Washington. His tireless commitment to ending racial segregation helped pave the way for the Voting Rights Act of 1965, and we continue to make good trouble in his honor.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101943112/527571409/-1125869122?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250211_f_BlackHistoryMonth_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDI5OGQzMy05YWU4LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yo-tKURHFKA0rOW2HaCIGsce_bul-99gsvne7y6cyD4=)
---
Fannie Lou Hamer spent her career fighting back against systemic racism present in elections. After facing violence and intimidation as barriers to voting, she helped form the Mississippi Freedom Democratic Party and pushed for greater racial equality in the political process. She was a key organizer of the 1964 Mississippi Freedom Summer and helped found the National Women’s Political Caucus, which remains active today.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101943113/527571414/-1125869122?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250211_f_BlackHistoryMonth_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDI5OGQzMy05YWU4LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yo-tKURHFKA0rOW2HaCIGsce_bul-99gsvne7y6cyD4=)
---
Born here in Atlanta, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. was one of the most influential Civil Rights leaders in the 1950s and 1960s. He was president of the Southern Christian Leadership Conference, and a key organizer of the March on Washington, where he gave his famous “I Have a Dream” speech. His activism was based on the tenets of nonviolence and civil disobedience, as well as his faith. Throughout his life, he used the power of his pen to inspire Americans to fight for human rights and to advocate for equality — including at the ballot box.
* * *
Through mobilization and education, Fair Fight is committed to supporting Black liberation, Black voters’ access to the ballot, and ensuring everyone’s vote counts. [**Your support today helps us combat the suppression and centuries-long disenfranchisement of Black voters in the United States as we work to ensure every voter’s voice is heard.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101943119/527571415/-1125869122?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250211_f_BlackHistoryMonth_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDI5OGQzMy05YWU4LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yo-tKURHFKA0rOW2HaCIGsce_bul-99gsvne7y6cyD4=)

clean_body: Help Fair Fight continue to fight for our freedoms | | | Team Fair Fight strongly believes that Black history is American history. During February, and throughout the year, we strive to honor the rich culture, resilience, and enduring legacy of the Black community. One of the key elements of the Civil Rights Movement was the fight for voting rights. During the Jim Crow era, literacy tests, poll taxes, and violent intimidation prevented Black people from exercising their right to vote, especially in Southern states. White lawmakers were desperate to stop communities they viewed as undesirable voting blocs from wielding power at the ballot box. The Voting Rights Act of 1965 was a hard-fought victory owed to years of tireless activism and unyielding bravery by Civil Rights leaders determined to put an end to Jim Crow voter suppression and the centuries-long disenfranchisement of Black voters in the United States. Take a moment to recognize the trailblazers who fought for justice and freedom, and who helped pave the way to make real the promises of democracy. | = Congressman John Lewis represented Georgia's 5th congressional district from 1987 until his death in 2020. He was a major force in the Civil Rights Movement, as a Freedom Rider, chairman of the Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee, and one of the organizers of the March on Washington. His tireless commitment to ending racial segregation helped pave the way for the Voting Rights Act of 1965, and we continue to make good trouble in his honor. = Fannie Lou Hamer spent her career fighting back against systemic racism present in elections. After facing violence and intimidation as barriers to voting, she helped form the Mississippi Freedom Democratic Party and pushed for greater racial equality in the political process. She was a key organizer of the 1964 Mississippi Freedom Summer and helped found the National Women’s Political Caucus, which remains active today. = Born here in Atlanta, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. was one of the most influential Civil Rights leaders in the 1950s and 1960s. He was president of the Southern Christian Leadership Conference, and a key organizer of the March on Washington, where he gave his famous “I Have a Dream” speech. His activism was based on the tenets of nonviolence and civil disobedience, as well as his faith. Throughout his life, he used the power of his pen to inspire Americans to fight for human rights and to advocate for equality — including at the ballot box. Through mobilization and education, Fair Fight is committed to supporting Black liberation, Black voters’ access to the ballot, and ensuring everyone’s vote counts. = Happy Black History Month! body:
Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico.

Chris said I could reach out with some exciting news, Derek:

Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico — my home — to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here. I’m humbly asking: **[Will you join us as a day-one donor by donating just $3 or more to my campaign and Rep. Chris Deluzio now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101944490/527576122/421187422?refcode=email_021125_haalandsplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDc2NTdiZC05YmU4LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_Xcn7AJ1IroDCnDdthkDP_GM6mEEkrsDqat0TXLNm-s=)**

The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve.

My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agriculture tradition that still continues today.

I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him.

I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.)

I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington.

I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us – strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope.

These are my stories.

These are stories of New Mexico.

These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children.

The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit?

I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation?

We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure everyone shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities.

I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children.

**[Will you join us with a day one donation, split between my campaign and Chris?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101944491/527576123/421187422?refcode=email_021125_haalandsplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDc2NTdiZC05YmU4LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_Xcn7AJ1IroDCnDdthkDP_GM6mEEkrsDqat0TXLNm-s=)** I would be honored to have your support.

Many thanks to Chris for helping spread the word. I hope you’ll join us, Derek!

Be fierce,

Deb

Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico.
# [](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/203?t=1&akid=93%2E181023%2ETsXld4)
Jocelyn said I could reach out with some exciting news:
Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico — my home — to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here.
I’m humbly asking: [**Will you join us as a day-one donor by donating just $3 or more to my campaign and Jocelyn Benson now?**](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/739?t=2&akid=93%2E181023%2ETsXld4)
The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve.
My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agriculture tradition that still continues today.
I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him.
I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.)
I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington.
I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us — strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope.
These are my stories.
These are stories of New Mexico.
These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children.
The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit?
I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation?
We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure everyone shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities.
I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children.
[**Will you join us with a day one donation, split between my campaign and Jocelyn Benson?**](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/738?t=3&akid=93%2E181023%2ETsXld4) I would be honored to have your support.
Many thanks to Jocelyn for helping spread the word. I hope you’ll join us!
Be fierce,
Deb

My Dear Friend, When I tell people my story, I hear the same things over and over again:“That’s crazy.” “I don’t believe that.” “That can’t be.”But if you’ve heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or Fox News, then you know it’s horribly true. My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son **James** in the photo above.I’ve spent the last decade fighting tooth-and-nail to keep school counselors, my ex-wife, and activist judges from “transitioning” **James** against my will. If you didn’t know, “transitioning” is the LGBTQ+ industry’s euphemism for sex change surgery or the chemical castration of a child.And if these radicals get their way, my son will be sterilized, traumatized, and dependent on Big Pharma for the rest of his life.This all started ten years ago when my ex-wife began telling me our two-year-old boy **James **wanted to become a girl.I ignored her and kept dressing my son in boy’s clothes. Because he’s a boy!But then I found out that after dropping him off at school, the school counselor would change him into girl’s clothes WITHOUT TELLING ME.The counselors and teachers also began calling him a different name, “Luna,” at school. Also without telling me!I assumed I’d be able to stop this madness during the custody hearings with my ex-wife. Instead, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.I would only be allowed to see James if I dressed him in girl’s clothes.My friend, I’ve never lied to my sons.And I’m not about to start now. So I was forced to stop visiting him.And then I began the fight of my life to save James from this evil “trans” culture.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers.I even authored a bill to outlaw sex change surgeries for minors in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee.And spent almost every dollar I had to make sure politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair.After I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, my ex-wife fled with **James** to California: a “trans sanctuary” state. I think you know exactly what happened once she got to California.A radical judge sided with my ex-wife and gave the greenlight to proceed with chemically castrating my son.I have never felt so helpless in my life. I am James’s father – yet I can’t protect him from the powerful LGBTQ+ activists who are using my ex-wife and our kangaroo court systems to turn my son into the poster child for their twisted and perverted agenda.I’ve watched the school system, my ex-wife, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.In fact, I can’t even appeal my case because the judge sealed the court records. I’d have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process.Worst of all, I am under a gag order to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Technically, my writing you this to you today is illegal.But I didn’t hesitate for one second to write it. If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time.But I’m not just some activist.I’m a father trying to save his son from the Left’s madness and butchery.This is what happens when you go up against the $6 BILLION “trans lobby” and radical activist judges.They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees...They’re trying to break my spirit...But I refuse to ever stop fighting for my son... for truth... and for what’s right. Because I don’t want this to ever happen to another family.These radical LGBTQ+ doctors, lawyers and judges need to be stopped...They need to be held accountable...And **James** needs to be **saved** before he’s permanently butchered.That’s why I’m writing to you today.When Patriots Legal Defense Fund (PLDF) heard about my case, they immediately offered to stand with me and fight this insanity.PLDF has been on the frontlines defending innocent J6ers targeted by the Biden DOJ.And when they heard about my case, they told me they’d help in any way possible.The fact is, this transgender madness is affecting all of our children and grandchildren. It’s in their schools. In the books in their libraries. Pediatricians are asking five-year-olds if they “feel like they’re in the wrong body” during routine doctor visits.This is madness. And it’s got to stop.If you want to help save my son **James **from castration and make sure this will NEVER happen to ANY child ever again... And if you want to send a message to these radical judges that their day of reckoning has come... # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39431%2E3422442%2E5dQkBk)
Derek, Katie Porter here.
Today my friend Deb Haaland is launching her campaign to be New Mexico’s next governor. Deb is a 35th-generation New Mexican, proud member of Laguna Pueblo, and former U.S. Secretary of the Interior under President Biden.
**[Can you split a $5 donation right now between Deb’s campaign and my organization, Truth to Power?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ms-dh-em-ttp?refcode=em20250211-39431&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39431_3422442_5dQkBk&akid=39431%2E3422442%2E5dQkBk)**
Deb and I were both elected to Congress in 2018. We were part of a big freshman class that came in during Trump’s first term, re-taking the House majority and finally holding the Trump Administration accountable. When Deb was elected to the House, she made history as one of the first two Native American women to be elected to Congress.
In 2021, Deb broke another barrier when she became the Secretary of the Interior. I was proud to work with her again to help bring federal resources back to Orange County to shore up our water supplies across Southern California. Deb visited Orange County in 2022 to see firsthand the innovations we've invested in.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ms-dh-em-ttp?refcode=em20250211-39431&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39431_3422442_5dQkBk&akid=39431%2E3422442%2E5dQkBk)
Deb and I also went to a school to talk with fourth graders about the Every Kid Outdoors program, which allows fourth graders and their families to visit our National Parks for free. This is a program with a special place in my heart, and I’m grateful Deb took the time to meet with some of the kids who had the chance to utilize the program.
[ Deb is running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children. **[Please consider making a donation that will be split between her campaign for governor and Truth to Power.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ms-dh-em-ttp?refcode=em20250211-39431&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39431_3422442_5dQkBk&akid=39431%2E3422442%2E5dQkBk)** [Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ms-dh-em-ttp?refcode=em20250211-39431&refcode2=39431_3422442_5dQkBk&akid=39431%2E3422442%2E5dQkBk) Katie Porter

Former U.S. Congresswoman Katie Porter founded Truth to Power to support the campaigns of her fellow Democrats. name: Stop Musk via Our Revolution
subject: Guess what Musk is coming after now?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

Bernie couldn’t be clearer:

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21469?t=1011&akid=7694%2E5885482%2E9KI5AU ][IMG]

But illegal or not, Musk is still at it – and now he’s come for the
watchdog responsible for protecting us from corporate corruption and
abuse, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB). Musk tweeted “CFPB
RIP” on Friday. Then employees were told not to come into work and the
bureau’s website went dark.

It’s not hard to see why. Musk is on a quest to give himself free rein to
do whatever he wants, whenever he wants – and CFPB was getting in the way
by protecting all of us from corporate abuse.

But here's the thing. Despite what Trump and Musk would like us to
believe, CONGRESS established the CFPB and controls the budget...so it’s
CONGRESS that would need to formally eliminate it, NOT an unelected
billionaire. That’s why we need to OVERWHELM our representatives with
demands to intervene and STOP MUSK from gutting our government.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21469?source=email-021125&t=1012&akid=7694%2E5885482%2E9KI5AU ]Our Revolution’s Citizen Action Team is working overtime, delivering
our voices straight to Congress. Will you add your name to growing chorus
calling on our reps to use their power to stop Elon Musk?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21469?source=email-021125&t=1013&akid=7694%2E5885482%2E9KI5AU ]ADD YOUR NAME

Musk has already seized payment systems putting everything from Social
Security to Medicaid on the line. This is another dangerous abuse of power
that is going to have clear consequences for ALL OF us.

The CFPB’s job is to protect consumers from predatory corporations by
issuing rules on things like medical debt and bank fees. So far, it has
secured $21 BILLION in consumer relief through things like compensation
and canceled debts – helping 205 MILLION consumers.

So of course Musk thinks he can just — poof! — make it disappear. And now
he has a new ally to help him: Project 2025 architect Russell Vought
just got installed as the new head of the CFPB. Vought already
unilaterally declared that the bureau won’t withdraw its next round of
funding from the Federal Reserve, even though Congress passed a law
directing it.

It’s illegal plain and simple. And it’s all part of a massively corrupt
plan to allow billionaires to take over our government. But we aren’t
powerless to stop the worst of this.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21469?t=1014&akid=7694%2E5885482%2E9KI5AU ][IMG]

The fact is, right now Congress is feeling the heat. Some Republicans have
even started to express concern about Musk's overreach. So NOW is the
moment to keep up the pressure and overwhelm our representatives with
calls for them to stand up for the American people and use the power we
gave them to rein in Elon Musk.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21469?source=email-021125&t=1015&akid=7694%2E5885482%2E9KI5AU ]We can’t let up now. WIll you send an urgent message to Congress
demanding it shut Musk down?

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: How does this help Ohio, Jim?
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Donald Trump just made another dangerous move, demanding that the FBI hand over the 5 thousand names of people who worked on the January 6th cases.
And we know exactly who’s poised to take this and run with it: Jim Jordan.
Jordan’s Judiciary Committee is already leading the so-called “investigation of the investigators,” turning the pursuit of truth about January 6th into a taxpayer-funded circus.
This sham “special subcommittee” isn’t about oversight—it’s about Trump’s revenge.
And now, Trump is handing Jordan another golden opportunity to crank up the chaos and peddle his deep-state conspiracy theories, and yep you guessed it, more opportunities to get featured on that FOX talk show. I won’t justify it by calling it news.
What does this mean for Ohio families?
Absolutely nothing.
While Jordan spends his time turning Capitol Hill into a three-ring circus, and building his name recognition, he’s ignoring the real needs of the people he’s supposed to represent.
Our movement is taking this no-show Congressman head-on, but we need your help to do it. Will you chip in $25, $50, $100, $1,000, $2,500, or $3,300 today to help us hold Jim Jordan accountable? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250211_Trump_FBI_Turnover_link1]
Has Jim Jordan ever used his position to address rising costs?
To create jobs? To make life better for working families? Of course not!
Instead, he’s laser-focused on defending Trump’s ULTRA-MAGA cronies and trying to rewrite the history of January 6th.
Make no mistake: This is the kind of authoritarian power grab that should terrify every American.
Trump and Jordan aren’t just wasting taxpayer money—they’re undermining trust in our institutions and attacking anyone who dares to hold them accountable.
That’s why we can’t afford to sit back.
Our movement is fighting against this chaos and we are demanding better for Ohio and the country. But we need your help.
Will you rush a contribution today to power our fight and show Jim Jordan that Ohio families are tired of his circus? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250211_Trump_FBI_Turnover_link2]
This isn’t just about Jim Jordan or Trump—it’s about defending democracy and putting the focus back on people, not political vendettas.
Let’s go!
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

The Hamilton County Reporter State Treasurer Daniel Elliott February 8, 2025
https://readthereporter.com/governor-braun-keeps-the-promises-he-makes/ [Click Here To Read](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/DEGa_djkuHm-fFehG84Cm5GCn_9PVBwfJ-8uniuEYf8kzDnllTTdhtcnWBa_wm9GcI8qgcw0jp2RbhisGJUauTwB-rSkrv2N0YZ4E9LGXeivWyhmrbkMOvJ7d5_L8DDn9F84eoe_1oEkigwkCFCPR02n-ssb_tKgdQcGpXDcRLGHIXFg708Hl4RuARF5hsGt_0CeA8dHoWrVo65m7ktsI3uIEXMZL9Ov54PujJ22AErqqKA15TWPc-WRrJQH1PZoWQqfzEUUsnbZLyi4IYHWdRWQXiExh2jtsoEDWP3wVka6fHjaoTbUXhu27-4Qy7HoyU4/HjF_CJQBfHjomZZ5-Wi1yRHZeenRrf7r/5) Every year, as State Treasurer, I visit all 92 counties to hear directly from Hoosiers about their concerns and what our state government can do to improve their lives. And everywhere I travel across the state, there is Mike Braun, listening to Hoosiers talk about their concerns. In just a few short weeks in office, Governor Braun has made it clear that the complex challenges our state faces will no longer be an excuse for state government inaction. As a small government conservative, I fully support his vision for a streamlined, accountable, responsive government that allows Hoosiers to keep more money in their pockets and his desire to reduce unnecessary regulations that stifle growth and drive up costs for Hoosier families and businesses. I come from Martinsville, so I know the importance of supporting the hard-working men and women of our rural communities. They face unique challenges. Governor Braun and I are committed to being their voice at the Statehouse. Any statewide elected official who spends time with their constituents has heard that property taxes are one of the biggest concerns for Hoosiers across our state. However, few politicians have been courageous enough to step forward with reforms that protect the funding of local government’s essential needs, like public safety and infrastructure, while also providing relief to taxpayers. Governor Braun’s clear support for property tax reform proves he has the strength and will to do what is right for Hoosiers. What’s most refreshing is that Governor Braun’s approach is the opposite of many in Washington. He wants to get things done and make government accountable. His executive orders will lead to 5 percent savings across state agencies, cut 25 percent of regulations across the board, and bring government workers back to the office. He understands that every dollar saved, every reform enacted, and every barrier removed translates directly to a better quality of life for Hoosiers. Unlike in Washington, where gridlock often prevents real solutions, Indiana has the opportunity to lead with a results-driven agenda. As State Treasurer, I work every day on managing the funds for two of Indiana’s newest school choice programs, and I could not be more excited to work with a governor dedicated to ensuring that all Hoosier families have access to the highest quality education. The Governor’s support for programs our office manages, like Indiana Education Scholarship Accounts (INESA) and Career Scholarship Accounts (CSA), shows he is serious about revamping our state’s approach to education to put parents back in the driver’s seat and sets our next generation up for success. I look forward to working with Governor Braun to make education in our state the best in the nation. These important issues – property taxes, government efficiency, and education – are only the tip of the iceberg. Governor Braun’s time in business and at all levels of government has given him the experience necessary to address issues that families talk about at their kitchen tables across our state. One thing that has become evident through the Governor’s successes in business, the Statehouse, and Washington, D.C., is that a promise made by Mike Braun is a promise kept, and our state could not be in better hands going forward. As State Treasurer, my office will continue to partner with Governor Braun to ensure no Hoosier is forgotten. By listening to people over politicians, Governor Braun will lead Indiana to its best future. _Daniel Elliott serves as the Indiana Treasurer of State._ [To Read The Full Article Click Here](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/p2cGIvPVcq0lKV7BeNRqEqeEE6CTaio9IWRUfkNpmOvMBecPPl-KMuZlc3P_5QxzHuqRgJq83Wt-3pvSvq-P8hZ_8Pa3miaMIz7xQcYtWoDdNwspR3EikRm8UxLwQiggvk_TWZkl_Z2_EdViQNEOzeOj02gkM56ylEQqULhjywj866__hEe2OcmFv-jKXb4pGyV3C_jm9Rx8mO82d5FcUMSFKrJd1nPRnUAncrCmJrKEgZUeO6nhtoIvJ7VgPhqZFT9F-mFuzsd1R0OhLHFX8aOyyHLY8a0Nuotsi_QFYTgaAQnYrXycmnnWOK4SRJzXHSo/6Q0tJwAYZSNAC4seOQCfiTJz4Zm4JoRf/5)

Trump is attempting to minimize the actions of the insurrectionists and downplay the impacts on our country.
Judge Baryl Howell said “No ‘process of national reconciliation’ can begin when poor losers, whose preferred candidate loses an election, are glorified for disrupting a constitutionally mandated proceeding in Congress and doing so with impunity.”
We must do our part to remember what truly happened on January 6th and commit ourselves to fighting for free and fair elections where the results are certified regardless to whetherMAGA republicans like the outcome.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101949869/527592933/-37655826?refcode=email_021125_davids-haaland-split&amounts=3,10,25,50,100,250,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OGVhZGQxNS1hNWU4LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xgOHxfEs3teIy32hsUnlv1FzuHPkdgZWefGgpdzAycQ=) Sharice Davids said I could reach out with some exciting news: Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico — my home — to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here. I’m humbly asking: [_**Will you join us as a day-one donor by donating just $3 or more to my campaign and Sharice Davids now?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101949870/527592934/13228646?refcode=email_021125_davids-haaland-split&amounts=3,10,25,50,100,250,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OGVhZGQxNS1hNWU4LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xgOHxfEs3teIy32hsUnlv1FzuHPkdgZWefGgpdzAycQ=) The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve. My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agriculture tradition that still continues today. I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him. I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.) I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington. I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us – strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope. These are my stories. These are stories of New Mexico. These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children. The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit? I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation? We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure _everyone_ shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities. I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children. [_**Will you join us with a day one donation, split between my campaign and Sharice Davids?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101949871/527592935/-37655826?refcode=email_021125_davids-haaland-split&amounts=3,10,25,50,100,250,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OGVhZGQxNS1hNWU4LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xgOHxfEs3teIy32hsUnlv1FzuHPkdgZWefGgpdzAycQ=) I would be honored to have your support. Many thanks to Sharice Davids for helping spread the word. I hope you’ll join us! Be fierce, Deb

DOGE slashes over $100M in DEI funding at Education Department: 'Win for every student'

The Department of Education (DOE) is canceling more than $100 million in grants to fund diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) training as part of the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) sweep of "wasteful" spending.

DOGE, the department led by Elon Musk to cut costs within the federal government, announced the termination of 89 DOE contracts totaling $881 million in a post on X Monday night.

Hegseth says DOGE welcome at Pentagon as Defense Department reviews military posture globally

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Tuesday that the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) is "welcome at the Pentagon," telling reporters in Stuttgart, Germany, during his first overseas trip at the helm that the Department of Defense (DoD) will also be reviewing U.S. military posture globally to account for different "strategic assumptions" between President Donald Trump and former President Joe Biden.

"As I said on social media, we welcome Doge to the Pentagon," Hegseth said. "And I hope to welcome Elon to the Pentagon very soon. And his team working in collaboration with us."

_(But don 't you worry, I'm about as pro-Trump as they come!)_

_My name 's Marlin Stutzman._ I'm a 4th-generation farmer raising the finest Wagyu cows this side of the Mississippi. When I'm not herding cattle and hauling hay, I'm fighting the good fight in the People's House.

I ran for office because the Democrats AND even some Republicans have stabbed farmers like me in the back for as long as I can remember.

Ask any farmer - they'll show you the scars.

**I swear elites in DC think meat and produce *magically appear* at Whole Foods - not because farmers devote their blood, sweat, and tears to their trade. **

That's how they can sleep at night knowing...
* China is buying up our farmland
* Democrats taxed us into oblivion
* Liberals want to replace beef with fake meat made from God knows what
* Politicians get rich at our expense
* We're left to pick up the scraps

My entire life is focused on bringing all that to a screeching halt. And the political class knows I can't be bought off or bribed. That's why they're mobilizing the powers-at-be to silence me so they can keep the gravy train rolling.

_And holding the line here will be tougher than a $3 steak._

**[That's why I'm left with no choice but to ask you for a small donation today to keep me in Congress.
