clean_body: The 2025 General Assembly Session | | | | 2025 SESSION THE HONEY BADGER REPORT | | | | | | | Wednesday What can you expect? | ATTEND IN PERSON OR CALL IN TO THE MEETING LIVE | Wednesday Senate Committee Meetings | == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == | AMANDA CHASE | VIRGINIA'S HONEY BADGER | Dear Hello To take a look at bills coming up tomorrow, just click on the names of the committees above. You'll probably recognize many of these bills. Many bills that are introduced in the Senate or also simultaneously introduced in the House. It's the exact same bill, only one has a House patron and the other a Senate patron. If you look carefully, you'll see that most of the bills we're seeing now are ones that have already been voted on as a Senate bill. Know that these bills will probably not get a second hearing in the Senate. Instead the committee chair will simply say, "We've already seen this bill," and then give the vote and how each Senator voted. Lots of gun grabbing House companion bills coming up at 7:30am tomorrow morning. At least 8 of them. We know they will pass, but you should still contact all senators who vote on the bill from subcommittee to the full Senate floor. That's the Public Safety and Claims Subcommittee senators, Members of the Finance Committee and then all Senators. More gun grabbing bills coming up at 9am before the Finance and Appropriations Committee. Please review the list above by clicking the committee. If you're watching Session in the Senate, you'll want to look at House Bills on Third Read. The bills on the uncontested calendar will pass in a block, unless a legislator pulls a bill out. Then bills on Third Read on the Regular Calendar will be debated. On the Senate floor, there is a bill that would set up the framework for creating a retail market that establishes a framework for creating market for cannabis aka marijuana. What a disaster for our kids. As a mother of 4, this bill really concerns me. More gun grabbing bills coming up in the Senate Courts of Justice Committee after session. That said, I'm not going to spend time on these companion bills. Instead I'm going to focus on what you will find in the Virginia Budget. Most American appreciate Elon Musk under President Trump's direction, finding and cutting all of the government fraud, waste and abuse. I think you will be surprised as to what you will find in the Virginia Budget. From now through the last day of session, I will highlight budget amendments that the Democrats have introduced. For a full listing, just click the "budget amendments" link. | | $6,000,000 The Virginia Office of Education and Labor Market Alignment in partnership with the State Council of Higher Education and the Virginia Department of Workforce Development and Advancement, and in consultation with agencies participating in the Virginia Longitudinal Data System, Virginia Workforce Data Trust, and nonprofit education partners shall evaluate the need to establish the Virginia Office of Education and Labor Market Alignment as an independent entity in state government with the primary responsibility for maintaining and allowing access to Virginia's education and workforce data systems by internal agency and qualified external organizations, addressing key education and workforce policy questions, and conducting research. The Virginia Office of Education and Labor Market Alignment shall provide the results of this evaluation to the General Assembly on or before December 1, 2025. $200,000 This amendment provides funding to the Commission Studying History of Uprooting of Black Communities by Public Institutions of Higher Education which is evaluating (i) whether any public institution of higher education in the Commonwealth has purchased, expropriated, or otherwise taken possession of property owned by any individual within the boundaries of a community in which a majority of the residents are Black in order to establish or expand the institution's campus and (ii) whether and what form of compensation or relief would be appropriate for any such individual or any of his lineal descendants. $250,000 This amendment provides $250,000 to the City of Richmond to support the Metropolitan Business League's and Bridging Virginia's Capital Access Program. This program provides resources to small businesses owned by individuals from historically marginalized communities and with economically disadvantaged backgrounds. $187,020 This amendment provides $187,020 to effectuate the provisions of House Bill 1922 of the 2025 General Assembly, which codifies Executive Order 35 related to Small, Women, and Minority owned business utilization in state contracts What government waste can you find? subject: I’m running
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico.
| The Voter Protection Project said I could reach out with some exciting news, folks:

Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico — my home — to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here.

[I’m humbly asking: Will you join us as a day-one donor by donating just $10 or more to my campaign and the Voter Protection Project now?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86794?t=6&akid=18894%2E878179%2EZmrTKw) If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Deb Haaland and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86795?t=7&akid=18894%2E878179%2EZmrTKw)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86796?t=8&akid=18894%2E878179%2EZmrTKw)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86797?t=9&akid=18894%2E878179%2EZmrTKw)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86798?t=10&akid=18894%2E878179%2EZmrTKw)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86799?t=11&akid=18894%2E878179%2EZmrTKw)
The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve.

My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agriculture tradition that still continues today.

I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him.

I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.)

I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington.

I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us – strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope.

These are my stories.

These are stories of New Mexico.

These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children.

The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit?

I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation?

We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure everyone shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities.

I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children.

[Will you join us with a day one donation, split between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86794?t=12&akid=18894%2E878179%2EZmrTKw) I would be honored to have your support.

Many thanks to the Voter Protection Project for helping spread the word. I hope you’ll join us, friend!

Be fierce,

Deb

(www.protectvoting.org)
Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. 401 2nd Ave. S, Ste. 303, Seattle, WA 98104

The Voter Protection Project is on an important mission: To end partisan gerrymandering and voter suppression by electing candidates at the state and federal levels that are forceful advocates for voting rights. Our enfranchisement agenda includes working to ensure that every state has automatic voter registration and online voter registration, convenient early voting, and independent redistricting commissions to ensure politicians are not able to draw their own maps.

Please, consider making a [one-time contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/121?t=1&akid=18894%2E878179%2EZmrTKw). **Or, to make the most powerful lasting impact and help us oust Republicans up and down the ballot who attack our right to vote, make a[monthly sustaining contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/122?t=2&akid=18894%2E878179%2EZmrTKw).**

| | Hi Peter, I'm really worried about the future of our children's education. A group of politicians is pushing to dismantle the Department of Education and I'm writing to you because we need to act now. This isn't just another political game. If these politicians succeed, our children will face overcrowded classrooms, fewer resources for vulnerable students, and cuts to essential services for students with disabilities. Our children's futures are at stake. But we're not powerless. We can stand up and make our voices heard.

On **Wednesday, February 12, at 4:00 PM,** educators, parents, community leaders, and elected officials are coming together in DC at the **Capitol Grounds (corner of Independence Ave SE & First Street SE) **to send a clear message: our children's education is not up for negotiation.

While Trump, Musk, and their allies are focused on causing as much harm and chaos as possible, Democrats’ focus remains on protecting the American people. We’ll keep fighting — and we’ll keep you updated as the work continues. Thank you, The Democrats

name: Lateefah Simon
subject: Hands off the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lateefah for Congress
body:
https://www.lateefahsimon.com [https://www.lateefahsimon.com]
Friend,
As we speak, Donald Trump and Elon Musk are shutting down the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, one of the few agencies in Washington with the sole mission of protecting Americans against corporate power.
But we won’t go down without a fight. Sign on today to send a message that Donald Trump and Elon Musk need to keep their hands off the CFPB. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/xD9xH_j3zUKbWrmLOZbLsg2]
Friend, I lost my late husband over 10 years ago, on Father’s Day of 2014. That night, I made a promise — I told him that I would tell our story every day of my life.
That’s why yesterday, I joined my colleagues to take a stand against this unconstitutional power grab, and I told our story.
When Kevin was a young Black journalist, and I was a young organizer with a young baby, I believed our whole future was ahead of us. Then, one fateful day, he was diagnosed with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia.
Doctors gave him three days to live. By the grace of God, he lived for two more years. But the cost — financially, emotionally, physically — was devastating. Like so many families navigating our broken healthcare system, we lost everything.
We filed for bankruptcy. We fought tooth and nail just to stay afloat.
That’s why I know, deep in my bones, that agencies like the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) are a lifeline. The CFPB has fought to ensure medical debt doesn’t keep families like mine from renting a home, getting a car, or securing a student loan.
They have returned over $21 billion to low-income and working-class families who were cheated by corporate greed.
And now, Donald Trump wants to shut it down. This is the cavalry for the downtrodden, the sick, the tired, the weeping, the disabled, the everyday people who have been left behind. Trump wants to dismantle it because he cares more about protecting billionaires than protecting working people. We can’t let him win. Sign on now to say: HANDS OFF THE CFPB! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/xD9xH_j3zUKbWrmLOZbLsg2]
HANDS OFF THE CFPB! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/xD9xH_j3zUKbWrmLOZbLsg2]
And listen, my fellow Democrats in Congress and I will fight every single day to protect working families. We will not back down — not today, not ever. But we need you with us. Add your name now. Let’s defend the CFPB and stop Trump’s attack on everyday Americans. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/xD9xH_j3zUKbWrmLOZbLsg2]
In solidarity,
Lateefah Simon

Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101961982/527634990/1004292363?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-02-11_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM0NjNhMTVlLWM3ZTgtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3Wpgmh4uxXeJl6ivljyMkrSoWPJU0HDkDT7jp4c9j8I=)
---
Fight for Progress said I could reach out with some exciting news, Peter:

Today, I’m launching my campaign for Governor of the great state of New Mexico — my home — to bring our state together and build a bright future for all who live here.

I’m humbly asking: [_**Will you join us as a day-one donor by donating just $3 or more to my campaign and Fight for Progress now?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101961984/527634995/1004292363?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-02-11_1&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM0NjNhMTVlLWM3ZTgtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3Wpgmh4uxXeJl6ivljyMkrSoWPJU0HDkDT7jp4c9j8I=)

The amount you give doesn’t matter. What matters is building a campaign with the support of real people. That’s who I am and who I came from. That’s who I am running to serve.

My roots in New Mexico run 35 generations deep. The Pueblo people were the first farmers in the high deserts of New Mexico, an agriculture tradition that still continues today.

I am here because of my grandfather, who worked for decades as a diesel mechanic on the railroad. Somehow he also kept a field — picking worms off the corn as it grew, like the generations before him.

I am here because of my grandmother, a survivor and a caretaker who woke up every day before the sun. She was the one who gave me my true love of cooking New Mexican cuisine. (She wouldn’t let us in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours.)

I am here because of my parents and their sacrifice. My mother, a Pueblo woman, served in the Navy. My father, a Marine, received a Silver Star for his service in Vietnam. He now lies in honor at Arlington.

I am here because of my beloved child, who I raised on my own. I started a small business to pay the bills, but it still wasn’t always enough. We relied on food stamps to get on our feet. I sometimes had to decide between paying rent and buying groceries to feed our family. I will never forget how that felt or the kindness of those who helped us – strangers who became community. When I look at my Somah, I see perseverance, strength and hope.

These are my stories.

These are stories of New Mexico.

These days, our differences are blown so far out of proportion. We lose sight of a simple fact: we all live in the same state, together. All of us in New Mexico come from love, survival, and sacrifice. We all want to live good lives — and we want even more for our children.

The current president and his billionaire friends look at the lands and the people of this country and think: what can I exploit?

I am running to ask: if we come together in New Mexico, what good can we do for each other and for the next generation?

We have our work cut out for us. The cost of living is crushing our families. Our economy is growing, but we need to make sure everyone shares in our progress. Our families need more. Our farmers and ranchers need more. New Mexico’s children need so much more. And we must be good stewards of the Earth, and preserve the rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests whose beauty sustains our communities.

I am running to do all this and more. I am running to serve all New Mexicans and make sure we’re leaving a better future for our children.

[_**Will you join us with a day one donation, split between my campaign and Fight for Progress?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101961985/527634996/1004292363?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-02-11_1&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM0NjNhMTVlLWM3ZTgtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3Wpgmh4uxXeJl6ivljyMkrSoWPJU0HDkDT7jp4c9j8I=) I would be honored to have your support.

Many thanks to Fight for Progress for helping spread the word. I hope you’ll join us, Peter!

Be fierce,

Deb

Peter,
Extremists in Congress are pushing an extreme anti-voter bill – the SAVE Act – that would make it harder, if not impossible, for millions of voters across the country to register to vote. **We need your help to stop it.**
The SAVE Act would force every voter to provide a passport or birth certificate every time they register or update their voter registration and would effectively end online and mail-in voter registration.
This would disproportionately impact military voters, rural voters, tribal citizens, survivors of natural disasters, working-class Americans, and the tens of millions of married women who have changed their names. About half of American citizens _**– nearly 150 million citizens –**_ do not have a passport, and elderly Americans are one of the demographics least likely to have a passport.
This bill isn’t about election integrity. It’s about silencing voters. There’s _zero evidence of widespread voter fraud,_ and states already have secure systems in place to verify voter eligibility. **The real goal of the SAVE Act? To make it harder for eligible Americans to vote.**

subject: "Fork in the road"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Trump and Musk are going after the money first, by taking access to the U.S. Treasury. **And they're going after career-level federal employees with the OPM**.
(You’re going to be hearing that a lot. That's the Office of Personnel Management.)
These are people who have spent decades managing Medicare payments, Social Security, our national energy systems. Our air traffic controllers are career professionals.
It is normal for a president to come in and largely dismiss a lot of the previous administration's political appointees. They have the right to do that.
Trump and Musk are gutting the career professionals who have _legal protections_ , who have _decades of experience_ , and we will see **they are playing with fire**.
So, Donald Trump gets sworn in. Elon Musk then puts pressure on Trump to dismiss the Federal Aviation Administration administrator.
**Now, why did he do that?** The FAA administrator was advocating for fines or other punitive measures on Musk because of violations at SpaceX around safety.
Days later, the Trump administration — through OPM, through Elon Musk — sends this ham-fisted letter out to virtually every air traffic controller saying, “We want you to leave your job, and we will offer you a ‘ _buyout_ ,’” whose legality is highly questionable.
**And what happens?** In an environment where air traffic controllers are already strained, we do not have enough air traffic controllers in the United States.
Now we have a plane crash that has occurred. **When we mess with federal government systems, lives are at stake**.
And this rhetoric that Musk and MAGA have made setting up this conspiratorial mentality, in order to get people to think that none of this matters, is designed for _exactly_ this kind of outcome.
**Elon Musk is a billionaire raiding the US federal government for personal profit, and for the profit of his friends**. Every single person that you saw standing behind Donald Trump at his inauguration is part of this.
But we do not have to comply with illegal activity — **even if that illegal activity is coming from the President and his billionaire donors**.
[Help us continue the fight with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250211.8Fc7az&refcode=em20250211-8126-P_FND_CTR_CTR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8126%2E2526796%2EllLcun)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250211.8Fc7az&refcode=em20250211-8126-P_FND_CTR_CTR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=8126%2E2526796%2EllLcun)**
I want you to understand that if you are feeling overwhelmed by the constant headlines — government changes over here, ICE raids over here, plane crashes over there — know that **you are not alone**.
Know that that is _exactly_ what this administration is trying to get you to feel. They are trying to induce a state of passivity among the general public.
So it is of personal importance for you — and it is also of political importance — to take a breath. That does not mean get apathetic.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20250211?refcode=em20250211-8126-P_FND_CTR_CTR&t=21&refcode2=8126_2526796_llLcun&akid=8126%2E2526796%2EllLcun)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20250211-8126-P_FND_CTR_CTR&t=22&akid=8126%2E2526796%2EllLcun)**

subject: This is an illegal power grab

body:
This move rewards billionaires and removes protections for Americans.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250211-1&t=1&akid=1726%2E587540%2EGeu16I)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250211-1?refcode=em20250211-1726&amount=5&refcode2=1726_587540_Geu16I&akid=1726%2E587540%2EGeu16I)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250211-1?refcode=em20250211-1726&amount=5&refcode2=1726_587540_Geu16I&akid=1726%2E587540%2EGeu16I)
Peter, Elon Musk and Donald Trump are now targeting the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, the watchdog agency tasked with protecting Americans from predatory practices by banks, mortgage companies, debt collectors, and more.
Gutting the CFPB will NOT make our government more efficient. The CFPB is already efficient. According to MSNBC, the agency has a budget of less than $1 billion – and has _already_ returned more than $21 billion to Americans’ wallets.
Let’s be crystal clear: Elon Musk and Donald Trump are engaging in this illegal power grab because the CFPB hurts the interests of Big Tech and the oligarchy.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250211-1?refcode=em20250211-1726&amount=5&refcode2=1726_587540_Geu16I&akid=1726%2E587540%2EGeu16I)
No one is arguing that we shouldn’t try to make our government more efficient. But destroying agencies like CFPB won’t make that happen – instead, it will reward billionaires like Elon Musk and remove protections for regular Americans.
Peter, the aging political class in Washington obviously doesn’t care about us. That’s why we need to replace them with a new generation of bold progressives.
**[Will you contribute $5 to help us elect young leaders who’ll fight back?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250211-1?refcode=em20250211-1726&amount=5&refcode2=1726_587540_Geu16I&akid=1726%2E587540%2EGeu16I)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

subject: (Results enclosed) Our grassroots survey was a success!

body:
Now that our team has had a chance to comb through all the survey data, we’re here with the results!
#
Last week we promised to give you an update after we concluded our grassroots survey. Now that our team has had a chance to comb through all the data, we’re here with the results!
_**First, we asked what concerns people the most about the Trump administration and the Republican majorities in Congress:**_
* By far, the most common themes were the administration’s **unconstitutional actions** and the **unelected billionaires** who are running the show.

* Many people expressed concern about the **erosion of democracy and rolling back of rights** for LGBTQ+ people, women, and people of color.

* Many also feared threats to critical programs like **Social Security, Medicaid, and Medicare** with DOGE employees unilaterally cutting off funds.

**Sarah shares all of these concerns** , which is why she’s working every day in Congress to hold the Trump administration and the unelected billionaires running it accountable. [**Will you pitch in $5 to help her stay focused on the fight?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250211-1?refcode=em20250211-1749&amount=5&refcode2=1749_21716_G701T6&akid=1749%2E21716%2EG701T6)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250211-1?amount=5&refcode=em20250211-1749&refcode2=1749_21716_G701T6&akid=1749%2E21716%2EG701T6)**
Even though this *is* a frightening time for the country, our survey wasn’t all doom and gloom. _**Our next question asked what’s continuing to give people hope in this moment:**_
* Many people responded that the numerous **lawsuits and court rulings** attempting to stop the administration’s unconstitutional actions are giving them hope that democracy will prevail.

* Some are finding hope in **elected officials** who are speaking out and taking action, and many are organizing to elect more Democrats and **take back Congress after the midterms.**

Things might look dark now, but public opinion turns quickly, and 2026 is right around the corner. Sarah believes there’s _always_ reason for hope, and she’ll never stop speaking up for what’s right.
[**But Sarah can’t do this work without your support. Will you pitch in $5 or whatever you can today to help her keep fighting for us in Congress?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250211-1?refcode=em20250211-1749&amount=5&refcode2=1749_21716_G701T6&akid=1749%2E21716%2EG701T6)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250211-1?amount=5&refcode=em20250211-1749&refcode2=1749_21716_G701T6&akid=1749%2E21716%2EG701T6)**
In solidarity,
Team McBride
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-footer?refcode=em20250211-1&t=1&refcode2=1749_21716_G701T6&akid=1749%2E21716%2EG701T6)**

subject: Fire Elon Musk

body:
| | | It’s pretty simple, Peter. Nobody elected Elon Musk. No government body confirmed him. He is taking over our government, including Medicare and Social Security, simply because he spent a quarter of a billion dollars on Donald Trump, and because too many of our representatives are deciding to let it slide. We need to make noise — a lot of it — to demand that our congressmembers use all of the tools at their disposal to get Elon Musk out of government.
